functions.name: InsertDocument
functions.documentation: Inserts a rich text format or plain text file into a RichTextEdit control, DataWindow control, or DataStore object. The new content is added in one of two ways:

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control, DataWindow control, or DataStore object in which you want to display the file. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control (or DataStore) must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file you want to display in the RichTextEdit control. Filename can include the file's path.

params.name: clearflag
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the new file will replace the current contents of the control. Values are: true -- Replace the current contents with the file false -- Insert the file into the existing contents at the insertion point

params.name: filetype
params.description: A value of the FileType enumerated datatype specifying the type of file being opened. Values are: FileTypeRichText! -- (Default) The file being opened is in rich text format (RTF) FileTypeText! -- The file being opened is plain ASCII text (TXT) FileTypeHTML! -- The file being opened is in HTML format (HTM or HTML) FileTypeDoc! -- The file being opened is in Microsoft Word format (DOC or DOCX) FileTypeXLSX! -- The file being opened is in Microsoft Excel format (XLSX) If filetype is not specified, PowerBuilder uses the filename extension to decide whether to read the file as rich text or plain text. If the extension is not one of the supported file type extensions, PowerBuilder attempts to read the file as rich text. To insert files with extensions such as INI, LOG, or SQL, you must specify FileTypeText!.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Character encoding of the inserted document. This parameter only applies to text files. You can specify the encoding of the inserted document. If the encoding is not specified, it will be automatically read from the BOM header. If there is no BOM header in the file, the encoding will be set as ANSI format by default. Values are: EncodingANSI! (default) EncodingUTF8! EncodingUTF16LE! EncodingUTF16BE!

params.name: controlname

params.name: Text

params.name: PictureName

params.name: Clicked
params.description: The name of the Clicked user event to be bound with the small button. The Clicked user event for the small button must have a long parameter for receiving the handle of the small button. For details, see Clicked .

params.name: Item
params.description: A small button item you want to insert.

params.name: servicereference
params.description: Reference to the Internet service instance

params.name: data
params.description: Blob containing the complete data requested by a GetURL or PostURL function

functions.name: IntHigh

params.name: long
params.description: A long value

functions.name: IntLow

params.name: long

functions.name: InvokePBFunction
functions.documentation: Invokes the specified user-defined window function in the child window contained in a PowerBuilder window ActiveX control.

params.name: activexcontrol
params.description: Identifier for the instance of the PowerBuilder Window ActiveX control. When used in HTML, this is the NAME attribute of the object element. When used in other environments, this references the control that contains the PowerBuilder window ActiveX.

params.name: name
params.description: String specifying the name of the user-defined window function. This argument is passed by reference.

params.name: numarguments
params.description: Integer specifying the number of elements in the arguments array. The default is zero.

params.name: arguments
params.description: Variant array containing function arguments. In PowerBuilder, Variant maps to the Any datatype. This argument is passed by reference. If you specify this argument, you must also specify numarguments. If you do not specify this argument and the function contains arguments, populate the argument list by calling the SetArgElement function once for each argument. JavaScript cannot use this argument.

functions.name: IsAlive

params.name: oleobject

functions.name: IsAllArabic

functions.name: IsAllHebrew

functions.name: IsNumber

params.name: string

functions.name: IsOverflowPage

functions.name: IsPBApp

functions.name: IsPowerClientApp

functions.name: IsRunningAsSolution

functions.name: IsStandardCompatible
functions.documentation: Checks whether the standard used by the current PDF document is compatible with the specified standard.

params.name: standard
params.description: The PDFStandard is the enumerated data type indicating the level of PDF/A conformance. Values are: PDF_None! (Default) PDFA_1a! PDFA_1b! PDFA_3a! PDFA_3b! PDFA_3u! PDF_Unknown! (It is unsupported to specify PDF_Unknown! as the argument value here because PDF_Unknown! is regarded as not compatible with any standard).

functions.name: IsTabbedViewEnabled
functions.documentation: Gets whether the TabbedView option of the MDI window is enabled or not.

functions.name: IsTime
functions.documentation: Reports whether the value of a string is a valid time value.

params.name: timevalue
params.description: A string whose value you want to test to determine whether it is a valid time

functions.name: IsValid
functions.documentation: Determines whether an object variable is instantiated -- whether its value is a valid object handle.

params.name: objectvariable
params.description: An object variable or a variable of type Any -- typically a reference to an object that you are testing for validity

functions.name: KeyCount
functions.documentation: Gets the total number of keys.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

functions.name: KeyDown
functions.documentation: Determines whether the user pressed the specified key on the computer keyboard.

params.name: keycode
params.description: A value of the KeyCode enumerated datatype that identifies a key on the computer keyboard or an integer whose value is the ASCII code for a key. Not all ASCII values are recognized; see Usage. See also the table of KeyCode values in Usage.

functions.name: LastPos
functions.documentation: Finds the last position of a target string in a source string.

params.name: string1
params.description: The string in which you want to find string2.

params.name: string2
params.description: The string you want to find in string1.

params.name: searchlength
params.description: A long that limits the search to the leftmost searchlength characters of the source string string1. The default is the entire string.

functions.name: Left
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from the beginning of a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to search

params.name: n
params.description: A long specifying the number of characters you want to return

functions.name: LeftA

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to search from left to right

params.name: n
params.description: A long specifying the number of bytes of the characters in the return string

functions.name: LeftTrim
functions.documentation: Removes spaces from the beginning of a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want returned with leading spaces deleted

params.name: removeallspaces
params.description: A boolean indicating that all types of spaces should be deleted

functions.name: LeftTrimW
functions.documentation: Removes spaces from the beginning of a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as LeftTrim in all environments.

functions.name: LeftW
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from the beginning of a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Left in all environments.

functions.name: Len

params.name: stringorblob

params.name: stringorblob
params.description: The string or blob for which you want the length in number of bytes

functions.name: Length
functions.documentation: Reports the length in bytes of an open OLE stream.

params.description: The name of an OLE stream variable that has been opened

params.name: sizevar
params.description: A long variable in which Length will store the size of olestream

functions.name: LenW
functions.documentation: Reports the length of a string or a blob. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Len in all environments.

functions.name: LibraryCreate
functions.documentation: Creates an empty PowerBuilder library with optional comments.

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the PowerBuilder library you want to create. If you want to create the library somewhere other than the current directory, enter the full path name.

params.name: comments
params.description: A string whose value is the comments you want to associate with the library.

functions.name: LibraryDelete
functions.documentation: Deletes a library file or, if you specify a DataWindow object, deletes the DataWindow object from the library.

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the PowerBuilder library you want to delete or from which you want to delete a DataWindow object. If you do not specify a full path, LibraryDelete uses the system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the DataWindow object you want to delete from libraryname.

params.name: objecttype
params.description: A value of the LibImportType enumerated datatype identifying the type of object you want to delete. The only supported object type is ImportDataWindow!.

functions.name: LibraryDirectory
functions.documentation: Obtains a list of the objects in a PowerBuilder library. The information provided is the object name, the date and time it was last modified, and any comments for the object. You can get a list of all objects or just objects of a specified type.

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the PowerBuilder library for which you want the contents. If you do not specify a full path, LibraryDirectory uses the operating system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: objecttype
params.description: A value of the LibDirType enumerated datatype identifying the type of objects you want listed: DirAll! -- All objects DirApplication! -- Application objects DirDataWindow! -- DataWindow objects DirFunction! -- Function objects DirMenu! -- Menu objects DirPipeline! -- Pipeline objects DirProject! -- Project objects DirQuery! -- Query objects DirStructure! -- Structure objects DirUserObject! -- User objects DirWindow! -- Window objects

functions.name: LibraryDirectoryEx
functions.documentation: Obtains a list of the objects in a PowerBuilder library. The information provided is the object name, the date and time it was last modified, any comments for the object, and the object's type. You can get a list of all objects or just objects of a specified type.

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the PowerBuilder library for which you want the contents. If you do not specify a full path, LibraryDirectory uses the operating system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: objecttype
params.description: A value of the LibDirType enumerated datatype identifying the type of objects you want listed: DirAll! -- All objects DirApplication! -- Application objects DirDataWindow! -- DataWindow objects DirFunction! -- Function objects DirMenu! -- Menu objects DirPipeline! -- Pipeline objects DirProject! -- Project objects DirQuery! -- Query objects DirStructure! -- Structure objects DirUserObject! -- User objects DirWindow! -- Window objects

functions.name: LibraryExport
functions.documentation: Exports an object from a library. The object is exported as syntax.

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the PowerBuilder library from which you want to export an object. If you do not specify a full path, LibraryExport uses the system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the object you want to export

params.name: objecttype
params.description: A value of the LibExportType enumerated datatype identifying the type of objects you want to export: ExportApplication! -- Application object ExportDataWindow! -- DataWindow object ExportFunction! -- Function object ExportMenu! -- Menu object ExportPipeline! -- Pipeline objects ExportProject! -- Project objects ExportQuery! -- Query objects ExportStructure! -- Structure object ExportUserObject! -- User objects ExportWindow! -- Window object

functions.name: LibraryImport
functions.documentation: Imports a DataWindow object into a library. LibraryImport uses the syntax of the DataWindow object, which is specified in text format, to recreate the object in the library.
functions.syntax: LibraryImport ( libraryname, objectname, objecttype, syntax, errors {, comments } )

params.name: libraryname
params.description: A string specifying the name of the PowerBuilder library into which you want to import the entry. If you do not specify a full path, LibraryImport uses the system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A string specifying the name of the DataWindow object you want to import.

params.name: objecttype
params.description: A value of the LibImportType enumerated datatype identifying the type of object you want to import. The only supported object type is ImportDataWindow!.

params.name: syntax
params.description: A string specifying the syntax of the DataWindow object you want to import.

params.name: errors
params.description: A string variable that you want to fill with any error messages that occur.

params.name: comments
params.description: A string specifying the comments you want to associate with the entry.

functions.name: LineCount

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, EditMask, MultiLineEdit, or RichTextEdit for which you want the number of lines

functions.name: LineLength
functions.documentation: Determines the length of the line containing the insertion point in an edit control.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit, MultiLineEdit, or EditMask in which you want to determine the length of the line containing the insertion point

functions.name: LineList

params.description: Instance name of the ProfileRoutine object.

params.name: list

functions.name: LinkTo
functions.documentation: Establishes a link between an OLE control and a file or an item within the file.

params.name: olecontrol
params.description: The name of the OLE control in which you want to insert a linked object.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the file name containing the data that you want to insert in olecontrol, with a link connecting the object in PowerBuilder to the original data. If you do not specify sourceitem, a link is established with the whole file.

params.name: sourceitem
params.description: A string that names an item within file name to which you want to link. The way you specify sourceitem is determined by the OLE server application.

functions.name: LinkToObject
functions.documentation: Links the current object to an object that already exists in the PDF document.

params.name: object
params.description: The object that the current object links to. The object type can only be one of the following: PDFText, PDFImage, PDFMultilinkText, PDFTextBlock, PDFPage.

functions.name: LoadDockingState
functions.documentation: Loads two arrays of equal size: type names of persisted sheets and the corresponding IDs.

params.name: regkey
params.description: The registry key where the information was stored using the LoadDockingState function.

params.name: windowtypes
params.description: A string array of window types for all the child windows that were persisted.

params.name: sheetnames
params.description: A string array of the unique IDs for the persisted child windows corresponding to the types in the sheetnames array.

functions.name: LoadFile
functions.documentation: Loads a JSON file to the JSONParser or JSONPackage objects.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONParser or JSONPackage object to which the JSON file will be loaded.

params.name: FileName
params.description: A string whose value is the file full name. Only the JSON or TXT file type is supported. If the function is called by JSONParser, the file content must be JSON formatted. If the function is called by JSONPackage, the file content must be JSON data of JsonObjectItem type.

functions.name: LoadInk
functions.documentation: Loads ink from a file or blob into an InkPicture control.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control into which you want to load ink.

params.name: t
params.description: A string containing the name and location of a file that contains the ink you want to load into the control.

params.name: b
params.description: The name of a blob passed by reference that contains the ink you want to load into the control.

functions.name: LoadPicture
functions.documentation: Loads a picture from a file or blob into an InkPicture control.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control into which you want to load a picture.

params.name: t
params.description: A string containing the name and location of a file that contains the picture you want to load into the control.

params.name: b
params.description: The name of a blob passed by reference that contains the picture you want to load into the control.

functions.name: LoadString
functions.documentation: Loads a JSON string to the JSONParser or JSONPackage objects.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONParser or JSONPackage object to which the JSON string will be loaded.

params.name: JsonData
params.description: (For JSONParser object) A JSON-formatted string. (For JSONPackage object) The JSON data of JsonObjectItem type.

functions.name: LoadWithDotNet
functions.documentation: Loads a .NET (6.0 or later) assembly.

params.name: assemblypath
params.description: The name and location of the .NET assembly (*.dll). The location can be an absolute path or a relative path. When a relative path is executed in the development environment, it is relative to the location of the PBL file that contains the application object; when a relative path is executed in the production environment, it is relative to the installation location of the application's executable file. If the DLL file is in the same directory as the application, you can concatenate the full path of the DLL file using the GetCurrentDirectory function (see code example below).

functions.name: LoadWithDotNetCore
functions.documentation: Loads a .NET Core assembly.
functions.syntax: objectname.LoadWithDotNetCore ( readonly string assemblypath {, string dotnetcoreversion })

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the DotNetAssembly object.

params.name: assemblypath
params.description: The name and location of the .NET assembly (*.dll). The location can be an absolute path or a relative path. When a relative path is executed in the development environment, it is relative to the location of the PBL file that contains the application object; when a relative path is executed in the production environment, it is relative to the installation location of the application's executable file. If the DLL file is in the same directory as the application, you can concatenate the full path of the DLL file using the GetCurrentDirectory function (see code example below).

params.name: dotnetcoreversion
params.description: The highest .NET Core version to be supported. 2.1 and later versions are supported. For example, if the value is 3, it supports 3.x, the latest release for version 3 which is currently installed on the machine. If the value is not specified, it supports the latest version currently installed on the machine.

functions.name: LoadWithDotNetFramework
functions.documentation: Loads a .NET Framework assembly.
functions.syntax: objectname.LoadWithDotNetFramework ( readonly string assemblypath {, boolean customappdomain })

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the DotNetAssembly object.

params.name: assemblypath
params.description: The name and location of the .NET assembly (*.dll). The location can be an absolute path or a relative path. When a relative path is executed in the development environment, it is relative to the location of the PBL file that contains the application object; when a relative path is executed in the production environment, it is relative to the installation location of the application's executable file. If the DLL file is in the same directory as the application, you can concatenate the full path of the DLL file using the GetCurrentDirectory function (see code example below).

params.name: customappdomain
params.description: Boolean whether to create a new appdomain to load the assembly. A new appdomain will automatically disconnect from the DLL to release the DLL when the application exits; otherwise, the DLL will be occupied until the PowerBuilder IDE exits. True -- to create a new appdomain to load the assembly. False -- (default) to use the default appdomain to load the assembly. It is recommended to set to False at runtime (when the application executable runs). For the custom appdomain parameter, you can learn more at https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.appdomain?Redirected from=MSDN&view=netframework-4.8 .

functions.name: Log
functions.documentation: Returns the natural logarithm of a number. For an ErrorLogging object, this function can be used to write a string to the log file maintained by the object's container.

params.name: n
params.description: The number for which you want the natural logarithm (base e). The value of n must be greater than 0.

params.name: errorlogobj
params.description: Reference to the ErrorLogging service instance

params.name: message
params.description: The text string you want to write to the log

functions.name: LogFile
functions.documentation: Gets operational log information to a file when sending an email. This function takes no effect when sending an email asynchronously. You can use OnSendFinished to get the error log when sending an email asynchronously.

params.name: smtpclient
params.description: A SMTP client object identifying the client in which you want to get the operational log information to a file.

params.name: filepath
params.description: The file path that stores the obtained operational log information. If the file exists, the information will be appended to it. If not, the file will be created.

params.name: append
params.description: Specifies whether the log information will be appended to the file. Values are: True -- (Default) The log information will be appended to the file. False -- The log information will cover the content of the file.

functions.name: LogTen
functions.documentation: Determines the base 10 logarithm of a number.

params.name: n
params.description: The number for which you want the base 10 logarithm. The value of n must not be negative.

functions.name: Long

params.name: lowword
params.description: An UnsignedInteger to be the low word in the long

params.name: highword
params.description: An UnsignedInteger to be the high word in the long

params.name: stringorblob
params.description: The string you want returned as a long or a blob in which the first value is the long value. The rest of the contents of the blob is ignored. Stringorblob can also be an Any variable containing a string or blob.

functions.name: LongLong
functions.documentation: Converts data into data of type longlong. There are two syntaxes.

params.description: An UnsignedLong to be the low word in the longlong

params.name: highword

params.name: stringorblob
params.description: The string you want returned as a longlong or a blob in which the first value is the longlong value. The rest of the contents of the blob is ignored. Stringorblob can also be an Any variable containing a string or blob.

functions.name: Lower

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to convert to lowercase letters

functions.name: LowerBound
functions.documentation: Obtains the lower bound of a dimension of an array.

params.name: array
params.description: The name of the array for which you want the lower bound of a dimension

params.name: n
params.description: The number of the dimension for which you want the lower bound. The default is 1

functions.name: mailAddress
functions.documentation: Updates the mailRecipient array for a mail message.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to address the message.

params.name: mailmessage
params.description: A mailMessage structure containing information about the message. If you omit mailmessage, mailAddress displays an Address dialog box.

functions.name: mailDeleteMessage
functions.documentation: Deletes a mail message from the user's electronic mail inbox.

functions.name: mailGetMessages

params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to get the messages.

params.name: messagetype
params.description: A string whose value is a message type. The default message type is IPM or an empty string (""), which identifies interpersonal messages. The other standard type is IPC, which identifies hidden, interprocess messages. Your mail administrator may have established other user-defined message types.

params.name: unreadonly
params.description: A boolean value indicating you want only the IDs of unread messages. Values are: TRUE -- Get IDs for unread messages only FALSE -- Get IDs for all messages

functions.name: mailHandle
functions.documentation: Obtains the handle of a mailSession object.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session for which you want the handle

functions.name: mailLogoff
functions.documentation: Ends the mail session, breaking the connection between the PowerBuilder application and mail. If the mail application was already running when PowerBuilder began the mail session, it is left in the same state.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session from which you want to log off

functions.name: mailLogon
functions.documentation: Establishes a mail session for the PowerBuilder application. The PowerBuilder application can start a new session or join an existing session.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session you want to logon to.

params.name: profile
params.description: A string whose value is the user's mail system profile or user ID.

params.name: password
params.description: A string whose value is the user's mail system password.

params.name: logonoption
params.description: A value of the mailLogonOption enumerated datatype specifying the logon options: mailNewSession! -- Starts a new mail session, whether or not the mail application is already running mailDownLoad! -- Forces the mail application to download any new messages from the server to the user's inbox. Starts a new mail session only if the mail application is not running mailNewSessionWithDownLoad! -- Starts a new mail session and forces new messages to be downloaded from the server to the user's inbox The default is to use an existing session if possible and not to force new messages to be downloaded.

functions.name: mailReadMessage
functions.documentation: Opens a mail message whose ID is stored in the mail session's message array. You can choose to read the entire message or the envelope (sender, date received, and so on) only. If a message has attachments, they are stored in a temporary file. You can also choose to have the message text written to in a temporary file.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to read a message.

params.name: messageid
params.description: A string whose value is the ID of the mail message you want to read.

params.name: mailmessage
params.description: A mailMessage structure in which mailReadMessage stores the message information.

params.name: readoption
params.description: A value of the mailReadOption enumerated datatype: mailEntireMessage! -- Obtain header, text, and attachments mailEnvelopeOnly! -- Obtain header information only mailBodyAsFile! -- Obtain header, text, and attachments, and treat the message text as the first attachment, storing it in a temporary file mailBodyAsFile! is not supported for Extended MAPI. It works as mailEntireMessage! when used in PowerScript code. mailSuppressAttachments! -- Obtain header and text, but no attachments

params.name: mark
params.description: A boolean indicating whether you want to mark the message as read in the user's inbox. Values are: TRUE -- Mark the message as read FALSE -- Do not mark the message as read

functions.name: mailRecipientDetails
functions.documentation: Displays a dialog box with the specified recipient's address information.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession identifying the session in which you want to display the detail information for a recipient.

params.name: mailrecipient
params.description: A mailRecipient structure containing valid address information. Mailrecipient must contain a recipient identifier returned by mailAddress, mailResolveRecipient, or mailReadMessage.

params.name: allowupdates
params.description: A boolean indicating whether updates to the recipient's name will be allowed. If the user does not have update privileges for the mail system, then allowupdates is ignored. The default is false. allowupdates is always true for Extended MAPI.

functions.name: mailResolveRecipient
functions.documentation: Obtains a valid e-mail address based on a partial or full user name and optionally updates information in the system's address list if the user has privileges to do so.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to resolve the recipient.

params.name: recipient
params.description: A mailRecipient structure or a string variable whose value is a recipient's name. The recipient's name is a property of the mailRecipient structure. MailResolveRecipient sets the value of the string to the recipient's full name or the structure to the resolved address information.

params.name: allowupdates
params.description: A boolean indicating whether updates to the recipient's name will be allowed. If the user does not have update privileges for the mail system, then allowupdates is ignored. The default is false. allowupdates is always false for Extended MAPI.

functions.name: mailSaveMessage
functions.documentation: Creates a new message in the user's inbox or replaces an existing message.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to save the mail message.

params.name: messageid
params.description: A string whose value is the message ID of the message being replaced. If you are saving a new message, specify an empty string ("").

params.name: mailmessage
params.description: A mailMessage structure containing the message being saved.

functions.name: mailSend
functions.documentation: Sends a mail message. If no message information is supplied, the mail system provides a dialog box for entering it before sending the message.

params.name: mailsession
params.description: A mailSession object identifying the session in which you want to send the mail message

params.name: mailmessage
params.description: A mailMessage structure

functions.name: Match
functions.documentation: Determines whether a string's value contains a particular pattern of characters.

params.name: string
params.description: The string in which you want to look for a pattern of characters

params.name: textpattern
params.description: A string whose value is the text pattern

functions.name: MatchW
functions.documentation: Determines whether a string's value contains a particular pattern of characters. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Match in all environments.

functions.name: Max
functions.returnType: The datatype of x or y, whichever datatype is more precise
functions.documentation: Determines the larger of two numbers.

params.name: x
params.description: The number to which you want to compare y

params.name: y
params.description: The number to which you want to compare x

functions.name: MD5
functions.documentation: Calculates the MD5 value of a blob.

params.name: crypter
params.description: The name of the CrypterObject object

params.name: variable
params.description: A blob whose value is the data you want to process with MD5. When using the system blob function to convert a string to a blob, it is recommended to specify its encoding argument to be EncodingANSI! (for English characters only) or EncodingUTF8!, otherwise, the default EncodingUTF16LE! will be used.

functions.name: MemberDelete
functions.documentation: Deletes a member from an OLE object in a storage. The member can be another OLE object (a substorage) or a stream.

params.name: olestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of type OLEStorage containing the member (substorage or stream) you want to delete

params.name: membername
params.description: A string specifying the name of the member you want to delete from the storage

functions.name: MemberExists
functions.documentation: Determines whether the named member is part of an OLE object in a storage. The member can be another OLE object (a substorage) or a stream.

params.name: olestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of type OLEStorage that you want to check

params.name: membername
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the member that you want to check

params.name: exists
params.description: A boolean variable that will store whether or not the member exists

functions.name: MemberRename
functions.documentation: Renames a member in an OLE storage. The member can be another OLE object (a substorage) or a stream.

params.name: olestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of type OLEStorage containing the member (substorage or stream) you want to rename

params.name: membername
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the member you want to rename

params.name: newname
params.description: A string whose value is the new name to be assigned to the member

functions.name: MessageBox
functions.documentation: Displays a system MessageBox with the title, text, icon, and buttons you specify.
functions.syntax: MessageBox ( title, text {, icon {, button {, default } } } )

params.name: title
params.description: A string specifying the title of the message box, which appears in the box's title bar.

params.name: text
params.description: The text you want to display in the message box. The text can be a numeric datatype (double or longlong), a string, or a boolean value.

params.name: icon
params.description: A value of the Icon enumerated datatype indicating the icon you want to display on the left side of the message box. Values are: Information! (Default) StopSign! Exclamation! Question! None!

params.name: button
params.description: A value of the Button enumerated datatype indicating the set of CommandButtons you want to display at the bottom of the message box. The buttons are numbered in the order listed in the enumerated datatype. Values are: OK! -- (Default) OK button OKCancel! -- OK and Cancel buttons YesNo! -- Yes and No buttons YesNoCancel! -- Yes, No, and Cancel buttons RetryCancel! -- Retry and Cancel buttons AbortRetryIgnore! -- Abort, Retry, and Ignore buttons

params.name: default
params.description: The number of the button you want to be the default button. The default is 1. If you specify a number larger than the number of buttons displayed, MessageBox uses the default.

functions.name: Mid
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from a specified position in a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string from which you want characters returned.

params.name: start
params.description: A long specifying the position of the first character you want returned. (The position of the first character of the string is 1).

params.name: length
params.description: A long whose value is the number of characters you want returned. If you do not enter length or if length is greater than the number of characters to the right of start, Mid returns the remaining characters in the string.

functions.name: MidA
functions.documentation: Temporarily converts a string to DBCS, then returns the specified number of bytes from the string, starting from a specified position.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to search.

params.name: start
params.description: A long specifying the position of the first byte you want returned. (The position of the first byte of the string is 1.)

params.name: length
params.description: A long whose value is the number of bytes you want returned. If you do not enter length or if length is greater than the number of bytes to the right of start, MidA returns the remaining bytes in the string.

functions.name: MidW
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from a specified position in a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Mid .

functions.name: Min
functions.returnType: The datatype of x or y, whichever datatype is more precise
functions.documentation: Determines the smaller of two numbers.

params.name: x
params.description: The number to which you want to compare y

params.name: y
params.description: The number to which you want to compare x

functions.name: Minute
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of minutes in the minutes portion of a time value.

params.name: time
params.description: The time value from which you want the minutes

functions.name: Mod
functions.returnType: The datatype of x or y, whichever datatype is more precise
functions.documentation: Obtains the remainder (modulus) of a division operation.

params.name: x
params.description: The number you want to divide by y

params.name: y
params.description: The number you want to divide x into

functions.name: ModifyData
functions.documentation: Changes the value of a data point in a series on a graph. There are two syntaxes depending on the type of graph.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph in which you want to modify data.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number of the series in which you want to modify data.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to modify the data.

params.name: datavalue
params.description: The new value of the data point. The datatype of datavalue is the same as the datatype of the values axis of the graph.

params.name: categoryvalue
params.description: The category for datavalue. The datatype of categoryvalue is the same as the datatype of the category axis of the graph.

params.name: xvalue
params.description: The new x value of the data you want to modify

params.name: yvalue
params.description: The new y value of the data you want to modify

functions.name: Month
functions.documentation: Determines the month of a date value.

params.name: date
params.description: The date from which you want the month

functions.name: Move
functions.documentation: Moves a control or object to another position relative to its parent window, or for some window objects, relative to the screen.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object or control you want to move to a new location

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the new location in PowerBuilder units

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the new location in PowerBuilder units

functions.name: MoveTab
functions.documentation: Moves a tab page to another position in a Tab control, changing its index number.

params.name: tabcontrolname
params.description: The name of the Tab control containing the tab you want to move.

params.name: source
params.description: An integer whose value is the index of the tab you want to move.

params.name: destination
params.description: An integer whose value is the index of the destination tab before which source is moved. If destination is 0 or greater than the number of tabs, source is moved to the end.

functions.name: Navigate
functions.documentation: Browses the specified Web page.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: url
params.description: The address of the page to browse.

functions.name: NavigateToString
functions.documentation: Loads a page from the specified HTML source code. This function will load and render the provided HTML as the top level document. This function will trigger all navigation events.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: html
params.description: The source code of the HTML page to be loaded.

functions.name: NextActivity
functions.documentation: Provides the next activity in a trace file.

params.name: instancename
params.description: Instance name of the TraceFile object

functions.name: Now
functions.documentation: Obtains the current time based on the system time of the client machine.

functions.name: ObjectAtPointer
functions.documentation: Finds out where the user clicked in a graph. ObjectAtPointer reports the region of the graph under the pointer and stores the associated series and data point numbers in the designated variables.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph object for which you want the object under the pointer, or the DataWindow control containing the graph

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control for which you want the object under the pointer

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: An integer variable in which you want to store the number of the series under the pointer

params.name: datapoint
params.description: An integer variable in which you want to store the number of the data point under the pointer

functions.name: OffsetPos
functions.documentation: Sets the offset for progress bar controls.

params.name: control
params.description: The name of the progress bar control

params.name: increment
params.description: An integer that is added to the start position of the progress bar control

functions.name: Open
functions.documentation: Opens a window, an OLE object, or a trace file, or a PDF document.

params.name: windowvar
params.description: The name of the window you want to display. You can specify a window object defined in the Window painter (which is a window datatype) or a variable of the desired window datatype. Open places a reference to the opened window in windowvar.

params.name: parent
params.description: The window you want make the parent of the child or pop-up window you are opening. If you open a child or pop-up window and omit parent, PowerBuilder associates the window being opened with the currently active window.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of windowvar.

params.name: olecontrol
params.description: The name of the OLE control into which you want to load an OLE object.

params.name: OLEsourcefile
params.description: A string specifying the name of an OLE storage file containing the object. The file must already exist and contain an OLE object. OLEsourcefile can include a path for the file, as well as path information inside the OLE storage.

params.name: sourcestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of OLEStorage containing the object you want to load into olecontrol

params.name: substoragename
params.description: A string specifying the name of a substorage that contains the desired object within storagename

params.name: olestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of type OLEStorage into which you want to load the OLE object.

params.name: readmode
params.description: A value of the enumerated datatype stgReadMode that specifies the type of access you want for OLEsourcefile. Values are: stgReadWrite! -- (Default) Read/Write access. If the file does not exist, Open creates it. stgRead! -- Read-only access. You cannot change OLEsourcefile. stgWrite! -- Write access. You can rewrite OLEsourcefile but not read its current contents. If the file does not exist, Open creates it.

params.name: sharemode
params.description: A value of the enumerated datatype stgShareMode that specifies how other attempts, by your own or other applications, to open OLEsourcefile will fare. Values are: stgExclusive! -- (Default) No other attempt to open OLEsourcefile will succeed. stgDenyNone! -- Any other attempt to open OLEsourcefile will succeed. stgDenyRead! -- Other attempts to open OLEsourcefile for reading will fail. stgDenyWrite -- Other attempts to open OLEsourcefile for writing will fail.

params.name: olestream
params.description: The name of a object variable of type OLEStream into which you want to load the OLE object.

params.name: streamname
params.description: A string specifying the name of the stream within sourcestorage that you want to open.

params.name: instancename
params.description: Instancename of the TraceFile object

params.name: filename
params.description: A string identifying the name of the trace file you want to read

params.name: filePath
params.description: The path and file name of the file to be opened. The path must be an absolute path.

params.name: password
params.description: If required, the password of the PDF file.

functions.name: OpenChannel
functions.documentation: Opens a channel to a DDE server application.

params.name: applname
params.description: A string specifying the DDE name of the DDE server application.

params.name: topicname
params.description: A string identifying the data or the instance of the application you want to use (for example, in Microsoft Excel, the topic name could be System or the name of an open spreadsheet).

params.name: windowhandle
params.description: The handle of the window that you want to act as the DDE client. Specify this parameter to control which window is acting as the DDE client when you have more than one open window.

functions.name: OpenDefaultDownloadDialog
functions.documentation: Opens the default download dialog. This function will trigger the IsDefaultDownloadDialogStateChanged event.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

functions.name: OpenSheet
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet within an MDI (multiple document interface) frame window and creates a menu item for selecting the sheet on the specified menu.
functions.syntax: OpenSheet ( sheetrefvar {, windowtype }, mdiframe {, position {, arrangeopen } } )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheet places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: position
params.description: The number of the menu item (in the menu associated with the sheet) to which you want to append the names of the open sheets. Menu bar menu items are numbered from the left, beginning with 1. The default value of 0 lists the open sheets under the next-to-last menu item.

params.name: arrangeopen
params.description: A value of the ArrangeOpen enumerated datatype specifying how you want the sheet arranged in the MDI frame in relation to other sheets when it is opened: Cascaded! -- (Default) Cascade the sheet relative to other open sheets, so that its title bar is below the previously opened sheet. Layered! -- Layer the sheet so that it fills the frame and covers previously opened sheets. Original! -- Open the sheet in its original size and cascade it.

functions.name: OpenSheetAsDocument
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet as a document within an MDI frame window for dockable windows.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetAsDocument ( sheetrefvar {, windowtype }, mdiframe, sheetname {, tabalign } )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetAsDocument places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

params.name: tabalign
params.description: A boolean that, when used, creates a new tab group and indicates the alignment of the sheets in the group. When true, the tabs in the group align vertically. When false, the tabs align horizontally.

functions.name: OpenSheetDocked
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet docked in a specified position within an MDI frame window for dockable windows.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetDocked ( sheetrefvar {, windowtype }, mdiframe, position, sheetname )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetDocked places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: position
params.description: An enumerated type that specifies where to dock the sheet: WindowDockLeft! WindowDockRight! WindowDockTop! WindowDockBottom!

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenSheetFromDockingState
functions.documentation: Opens one or more persisted sheets within an MDI frame window for dockable windows.

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetFromDockingState places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenSheetInTabGroup
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet in a tab group within an MDI frame window for dockable windows.

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetInTabGroup places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: siblingname
params.description: The name of a sibling window in either a docked state or in a non-document tab group. The sheet opens in that tab group.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenSheetWithParm
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet within an MDI (multiple document interface) frame window and creates a menu item for selecting the sheet on the specified menu, as OpenSheet does. OpenSheetWithParm also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened sheet.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetWithParm ( sheetrefvar, parameter {, windowtype }, mdiframe {, position {, arrangeopen } } )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetWithParm places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the sheet is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Numeric PowerObject

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of the MDI frame window in which you want to open this sheet.

params.name: position
params.description: The number of the menu item (in the menu associated with the sheet) to which you want to append the names of the open sheets. Menu bar menu items are numbered from the left, beginning with 1. The default is to list the open sheets under the next-to-last menu item.

params.name: arrangeopen
params.description: A value of the ArrangeOpen enumerated datatype specifying how you want the sheets arranged in the MDI frame when they are opened: Cascaded! -- (Default) Cascade the sheet relative to other open sheets so that its title bar is below the previously opened sheet. Layered! -- Layer the sheet so that it fills the frame and covers previously opened sheets. Original! -- Open the sheet in its original size and cascade it.

functions.name: OpenSheetWithParmAsDocument
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet as a document within an MDI frame window for dockable windows. OpenSheetWithParmAsDocument also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened sheet.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetWithParmAsDocument ( sheetrefvar, parameter {, windowtype }, mdiframe, sheetname {, tabalign } )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetWithParmAsDocument places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the sheet is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Double PowerObject

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

params.name: tabalign
params.description: A boolean that, when used, creates a new tab group and indicates the alignment of the sheets in the group. When true, the tabs in the group align vertically. When false, the tabs align horizontally.

functions.name: OpenSheetWithParmDocked
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet docked in a specified position within an MDI frame window for dockable windows. OpenSheetWithParmDocked also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened sheet.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetWithParmDocked ( sheetrefvar, parameter {, windowtype }, mdiframe, position, sheetname )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetWithParmDocked places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the sheet is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Double PowerObject

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: position
params.description: An enumerated type that specifies where to dock the sheet: WindowDockLeft! WindowDockRight! WindowDockTop! WindowDockBottom!

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenSheetWithParmFromDockingState
functions.documentation: Opens one or more persisted sheets within an MDI frame window for dockable windows. OpenSheetWithParmFromDockingState also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened sheet.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetWithParmFromDockingState ( sheetrefvar, parameter {, windowtype }, mdiframe, sheetname )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetWithParmFromDockingState places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the sheet is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Double PowerObject

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: mdiframe
params.description: The name of an MDI frame window.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenSheetWithParmInTabGroup
functions.documentation: Opens a sheet in a tab group within an MDI frame window for dockable windows. OpenSheetWithParmInTabGroup also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened sheet.
functions.syntax: OpenSheetWithParmInTabGroup ( sheetrefvar, parameter {, windowtype }, siblingname, sheetname )

params.name: sheetrefvar
params.description: The name of any window variable that is not an MDI frame window. OpenSheetInwithParmTabGroup places a reference to the open sheet in sheetrefvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the sheet is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Double PowerObject

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of sheetrefvar.

params.name: siblingname
params.description: The name of a sibling window in either a docked state or in a non-document tab group. The sheet opens in that tab group.

params.name: sheetname
params.description: A unique string identifier for the sheet, which is used when layout is persisted.

functions.name: OpenTab
functions.documentation: Opens a visual user object and makes it a tab page in the specified Tab control and makes all its properties and controls available to scripts.

params.name: tabcontrolname
params.description: The name of the Tab control in which you want to open the user object as a tab page.

params.name: userobjectvar
params.description: The name of the custom visual user object you want to open as a tab page. You can specify a custom visual user object defined in the User Object painter (which is a user object datatype) or a variable of the desired user object datatype. OpenTab places a reference to the opened custom visual user object in userobjectvar.

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the tab before which you want to insert the new tab. If index is 0 or greater than the number of tabs, the tab page is inserted at the end.

params.name: userobjecttype
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the user object you want to open. The datatype of userobjecttype must be a descendant of userobjectvar.

functions.name: OpenTabWithParm
functions.documentation: Adds a visual user object to the specified window and makes all its properties and controls available to scripts, as OpenTab does. OpenTabWithParm also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened object.

params.name: tabcontrolname
params.description: The name of the Tab control in which you want to open the user object as a tab page.

params.name: userobjectvar
params.description: The name of the custom visual user object you want to open as a tab page. You can specify a custom visual user object defined in the User Object painter (which is a user object datatype) or a variable of the desired user object datatype. OpenTabWithParm places a reference to the opened custom visual user object in userobjectvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the user object is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Numeric PowerObject

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the tab before which you want to insert the new tab. If index is 0 or greater than the number of tabs, the tab page is inserted at the end.

params.name: userobjecttype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the user object you want to open. The datatype of userobjecttype must be a descendant of userobjectvar.

functions.name: OpenURL
functions.documentation: Opens the default Web browser and runs the specified URL in the browser.

params.name: url
params.description: String specifying the URL to open in the default Web browser

functions.name: OpenUserObject
functions.documentation: Adds a user object to a window or visual user object and makes all its properties and controls available to scripts.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the window or user object in which to open the target user object.

params.name: targetobjectvar
params.description: The name of the user object you want to display. You can specify a user object defined in the User Object painter (which is a user object datatype) or a variable of the desired user object datatype. OpenUserObject places a reference to the opened user object in targetobjectvar.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the target object within the first object's frame. The default is 0.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the target object within the first object's frame. The default is 0.

params.name: targetobjecttype
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the user object you want to display. The datatype of targetobjecttype must be a descendant of targetobjectvar.

functions.name: OpenUserObjectWithParm
functions.documentation: Adds a user object to a window or visual user object and makes all its properties and controls available to scripts, as OpenUserObject does. OpenUserObjectWithParm also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the window or user object in which to open the target user object.

params.name: targetobjectvar
params.description: The name of the target object you want to display. You can specify a user object defined in the User Object painter (which is a user object datatype) or a variable of the desired user object datatype. OpenUserObject places a reference to the opened target object in targetobjectvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the target object is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Numeric PowerObject

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the target object within the objectname object. The default is 0.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the target object within the objectname object. The default is 0.

params.name: targetobjecttype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the target object to open. The datatype of targetobjecttype must be a descendant of targetobjectvar.

functions.name: OpenWithParm
functions.documentation: Displays a window and makes all its properties and controls available to scripts, as Open does. OpenWithParm also stores a parameter in the system's Message object so that it is accessible to the opened window.

params.name: windowvar
params.description: The name of the window you want to display. You can specify a window object defined in the Window painter (which is a window datatype) or a variable of the desired window datatype. OpenWithParm places a reference to the open window in windowvar.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter you want to store in the Message object when the window is opened. Parameter must have one of these datatypes: String Numeric PowerObject

params.name: parent
params.description: The window you want make the parent of the child or pop-up window you are opening. If you open a child or pop-up window and omit parent, PowerBuilder associates the window being opened with the currently active window.

params.name: windowtype
params.description: A string whose value is the datatype of the window you want to open. The datatype of windowtype must be the same or a descendant of windowvar.

functions.name: OutgoingCallList
functions.documentation: Provides a list of the calls to other routines included in a performance analysis model.

params.name: instancename
params.description: Instance name of the ProfileLine or ProfileRoutine object.

params.name: list
params.description: An unbounded array variable of datatype ProfileCall in which OutgoingCallList stores a ProfileCall object for each call to other routines from within this routine. This argument is passed by reference.

params.name: aggregate
params.description: A boolean indicating whether duplicate routine calls will result in the creation of a single or of multiple ProfileCall objects.

functions.name: PageCount
functions.documentation: Returns the total number of pages in the document in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want the page count

functions.name: PageCreated
functions.documentation: Reports whether a tab page has been created.

params.name: userobject
params.description: The name of the tab page whose existence you want to test

functions.name: ParentWindow
functions.documentation: Obtains the parent window of a window.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of a window for which you want to obtain the parent object

functions.name: Paste
functions.returnType: Integer for DataWindow, InkEdit, and list boxes, Long for other controls
functions.documentation: Inserts (pastes) the contents of the clipboard into the specified control. For editable controls, text on the clipboard is pasted at the insertion point. For OLE controls, the OLE object on the clipboard replaces any object already in the control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, EditMask, InkEdit, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, RichTextEdit, DropDownListBox, DropDownPictureListBox, or OLE control into which you want to insert the contents of the clipboard. If controlname is a DataWindow, text is pasted into the edit control over the current row and column. If controlname is a DropDownListBox or DropDownPictureListBox, the AllowEdit property must be true

functions.name: PasteLink
functions.documentation: Pastes a link to the contents of the clipboard into the control. The server application for the object on the clipboard must be running.

params.name: olecontrol
params.description: The name of the OLE control into which you want to paste the object on the clipboard

functions.name: PasteRTF
functions.documentation: Pastes rich text data from a string into a DataWindow control, DataStore object, or RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, DataStore object, or RichTextEdit control into which you want to paste data in rich text format. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control or DataStore must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

params.name: richtextstring
params.description: A string whose value is data with rich text formatting.

params.name: band
params.description: A value of the Band enumerated datatype specifying the band into which the rich text data is pasted. Values are: Detail! -- The data is pasted into the detail band Header! -- The data is pasted into the header band Footer! -- The data is pasted into the footer band The default is the band that contains the insertion point.

functions.name: PasteSpecial
functions.documentation: Paste the content of the clipboard in a specified control.

params.name: olecontrol
params.description: The name of the OLE control into which you want to paste the object on the clipboard

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control into which you want to paste the content of the clipboard in a specified format into the current position

params.name: ClipBoardFormat
params.description: The format for the contents of the clipboard. Values for ClipBoardFormat are: ClipFormatText! ClipFormatRTF! (newly added) -- Specifies RTF format (Rich Text Format). ClipFormatImage! (newly added) -- Specifies an image. The image can be pasted if it is a device-dependent or a device-independent bitmap, a TIFF image or a Windows metafile. ClipFormatTIFF! ClipFormatDIB! ClipFormatBitmap! ClipFormatHTML! (newly added) -- Specifies HTML (Hypertext Markup Language) format. ClipFormatTXText! (newly added) -- Specifies formatted text in the internal TX Text Control format. ClipFormatTXTextFrame! (newly added) -- Specifies a TX Text Control text frame and its contents. The clipboard also contains information about how the text frame is positioned in the document (inline or geometrically positioned). ClipFormatTXImage! (newly added) -- Specifies an image including information about how the image is positioned in the document (inline or geometrically positioned).

functions.name: PauseDownload
functions.documentation: Suspends the download progress of the file.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: ItemId
params.description: The ID used to identify the file. The minimum value is 1. ItemId should be the return value of DownloadingStart or DownloadingStateChanged event.

functions.name: PBGetMenuString
functions.documentation: Gets the name of the item at a given position in a menu.

params.name: hmenu
params.description: A long for the menu handle

params.name: nPos
params.description: An integer for the position of the menu item, counting from 0 at the leftmost or topmost position

params.name: caption
params.description: A string passed by reference that captures the name (Text property) of the menu item

params.name: nMaxLength
params.description: An integer that sets the maximum length of the value passed in the caption argument

functions.name: Pi
functions.documentation: Multiplies pi by a specified number.

params.name: n
params.description: The number you want to multiply by pi (3.14159265358979323...)

functions.name: PixelsToUnits
functions.documentation: Converts pixels to PowerBuilder units. Because pixels are not usually square, you also specify whether you are converting the pixels' horizontal or vertical measurement.

params.name: pixels
params.description: An integer or long whose value is the number of pixels you want to convert to PowerBuilder units.

params.name: type
params.description: A value of the ConvertType enumerated datatype value indicating how to convert the value: XPixelsToUnits! -- Convert the pixels in the horizontal direction. YPixelsToUnits! -- Convert the pixels in the vertical direction.

functions.name: Play
functions.documentation: Starts playing an animation (an AVI clip).

params.name: animationname
params.description: The name of the animation control displaying the AVI clip.

params.name: from
params.description: A long value in the range 0 to 65,535 indicating the frame where playing starts.The value 0 starts playing the clip at the first frame.

params.name: to
params.description: A long value in the range -1 to 65,535 indicating the frame where playing ends. The value -1 stops playing the clip at the last frame.

params.name: replay
params.description: A long value in the range -1 to 65,535 indicating the number of times to replay the clip. The value -1 continues playing the clip indefinitely.

functions.name: PointerX
functions.documentation: Determines the distance of the pointer from the left edge of the specified object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the control or window for which you want the pointer's distance from the left edge. If you do not specify objectname, PointerX reports the distance from the left edge of the current sheet or window.

functions.name: PointerY
functions.documentation: Determines the distance of the pointer from the top of the specified object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the control or window for which you want the pointer's distance from the top. If you do not specify objectname, PointerY reports the distance from the top of the current sheet or window.

functions.name: PopMenu
functions.documentation: Displays a menu at the specified location.

params.name: menuname
params.description: The fully qualified name of a menu on a menu bar you want to display at the specified location

params.name: xlocation
params.description: The distance in PowerBuilder units of the displayed menu from the left edge of the window

params.name: ylocation
params.description: The distance in PowerBuilder units of the displayed menu from the top of the window

functions.name: PopulateError
functions.documentation: Fills in the Error object without causing a SystemError event.

params.name: number
params.description: The integer to be stored in the number property of the Error object

params.name: text
params.description: The string to be stored in text property of the Error object

functions.name: Pos
functions.documentation: Finds one string within another string.

params.name: string1
params.description: The string in which you want to find string2.

params.name: string2
params.description: The string you want to find in string1.

params.name: start
params.description: A long indicating where the search will begin in string1. The default is 1.

functions.name: PosA
functions.documentation: Temporarily converts a string from Unicode to DBCS based on the current locale, then finds one string within another string.

params.name: string1
params.description: The string in which you want to find string2.

params.name: string2
params.description: The string you want to find in string1.

params.name: start
params.description: A long indicating the position in string1 where the search will begin. The position is indicated by the number of bytes you specify for this argument. The default is 1.

functions.name: Position
functions.returnType: Integer for DataWindow, InkEdit, and list boxes, Long for other controls
functions.documentation: Reports the position of the insertion point in an editable control.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, EditMask, InkEdit, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, or DropDownListBox, or DropDownPictureListBox control in which you want to find the location of the insertion point

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit or DataWindow control in which you want to find the location of the insertion point or selected text. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

params.name: fromline
params.description: A long variable in which you want to save the number of the line where the insertion point or the start of the selection is.

params.name: fromchar
params.description: A long variable in which you want to save the number in the line of the first character in the selection or after the insertion point.

params.name: toline
params.description: A long variable in which you want to save the number of the line where the selection ends.

params.name: tochar
params.description: A long variable in which you want to save the number in the line of the character before which the selection ends.

functions.name: Post
functions.documentation: Adds a message to the message queue for a window, either a PowerBuilder window or window of another application.

params.name: handle
params.description: A long whose value is the system handle of a window (that you have created in PowerBuilder or another application) to which you want to post a message.

params.name: message#
params.description: An UnsignedInteger whose value is the system message number of the message you want to post.

params.name: word
params.description: A long whose value is the integer value of the message. If this argument is not used by the message, enter 0.

params.name: long
params.description: The long value of the message or a string.

functions.name: PostData
functions.documentation: Sends the string or blob data with POST method.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the HTTPClient object for which you want to post the data.

params.name: data
params.description: A string or blob value specifying the data to post.

params.name: bufferSize
params.description: A long value specifying the buffer size. For the string data, each PowerBuilder character takes up two bytes of storage.

functions.name: PostDataEnd
functions.documentation: Finishes sending the data with POST method.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the HTTPClient object for which you want to end posting data.

functions.name: PostDataStart
functions.documentation: Starts sending the data with POST method. If IgnoreServerCertificate or CheckForServerCertRevocation is set to verify the server certificate, and if the verification fails, an error code will be returned.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the HTTPClient object for which you want to start posting data.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string value specifying the URL.

functions.name: PostEvent
functions.documentation: Adds an event to the end of the event queue of an object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of any PowerBuilder object or control (except an application) that has events associated with it.

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for objectname and a script must exist for the event in objectname.

params.name: word
