params.description: A long value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs).

params.name: long
params.description: A long value or a string that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage).

functions.name: PostJsonWebMessage
functions.documentation: Sends the web message in the JSON format to the top-level document in WebBrowser asynchronously.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: json
params.description: The message (in JSON format) to be sent to the top-level document, for example: "{\"a\": \"b\"}"

functions.name: PostStringWebMessage
functions.documentation: Sends the web message in a simple string (rather than a JSON string) to the top-level document in WebBrowser asynchronously.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: webmessage
params.description: The message (in simple string format) to be sent to the top-level document, for example: "{'a': 'b'}" "1.2" "example"

functions.name: PostURL
functions.documentation: Performs an HTTP Post, allowing a PowerBuilder application to send a request through CGI, NSAPI, or ISAPI.

params.name: servicereference
params.description: Reference to the Internet service instance.

params.name: urlname
params.description: String specifying the URL to post.

params.name: urldata
params.description: Blob specifying arguments to the URL specified by urlname.

params.name: headers
params.description: String specifying HTML headers. In Netscape, a newline (~n) is required after each HTTP header and a final newline after all headers.

params.name: serverport
params.description: Specifies the server port number for the request. The default value for this argument is 0, which means that the port number is determined by the system (port 80 for HTTP requests).

params.name: data
params.description: InternetResult instance into which the function returns HTML.

functions.name: PosW
functions.documentation: Finds one string within another string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Pos in all environments.

functions.name: PowerBuilder.RegisteredObject.TriggerEvent
functions.documentation: PowerBuilder.RegisteredObject.TriggerEvent is a .NET method, not a PowerScript method. It is called in the C# code to trigger the event of the PowerBuilder object. For details, refer to Triggering PowerScript events from C# code in Application Techniques .
functions.syntax: int RegisteredObject.TriggerEvent(string registeredObject, string eventName{,string eventParam}{,ref string returnValue})

params.name: registeredObject
params.description: The registered name of PowerBuilder object that is case-sensitive.

params.name: eventName
params.description: The event name to be triggered.

params.name: eventParam
params.description: The parameter of the event.

params.name: returnValue
params.description: The return value of the event.

functions.name: Preview
functions.documentation: Displays the contents of a RichTextEdit control as either a preview of the document as it would print or in an editing view.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control which you want to preview or edit.

params.name: previewsetting
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether to put the RichTextEdit into preview or edit mode. Values are: True -- Preview the contents of the RichTextEdit as it would look when printed False -- Displays the contents in editable form

functions.name: Print
functions.documentation: Sends data to the current printer (or spooler, if the user has a spooler set up). There are several syntaxes. For syntax for DataWindows or DataStores, see the Print method for DataWindows in the section called “Print” in DataWindow Reference .
functions.syntax: objectname.Print ( printjobnumber, x, y {, width, height } )

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object that you want to print. The object must either be a window or an object whose ancestor type is DragObject, which includes all the controls that you can place in a window.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigns to the print job.

params.name: x
params.description: An integer whose value is the x coordinate on the page of the left corner of the object, in thousandths of an inch.

params.name: y
params.description: An integer whose value is the y coordinate on the page of the left corner of the object, in thousandths of an inch.

params.name: width
params.description: An integer specifying the printed width of the object in thousandths of an inch. If omitted, PowerBuilder uses the object's original width.

params.name: height
params.description: An integer specifying the printed height of the object in thousandths of an inch. If omitted, PowerBuilder uses the object's original height.

params.name: tab1
params.description: The position, measured from the left edge of the print area in thousandths of a inch, to which the print cursor should move before string is printed. If the print cursor is already at or beyond the position or if you omit tab1, Print starts printing at the current position of the print cursor.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to print. If the string includes carriage return-newline character pairs (~r~n), the string will print on multiple lines. However, the initial tab position is ignored on subsequent lines.

params.name: tab2
params.description: The new position, measured from the left edge of the print area in thousandths of a inch, of the print cursor after string printed. If the print cursor is already at or beyond the specified position, Print ignores tab2 and the print cursor remains at the end of the text. If you omit tab2, Print moves the print cursor to the beginning of a new line.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control whose contents you want to print.

params.name: copies
params.description: An integer specifying the number of copies you want to print.

params.name: pagerange
params.description: A string describing the pages you want to print. To print all pages, specify an empty string (""). To specify a subset of pages, use dashes to specify a range and commas to separate ranges and individual page numbers, for example, "1-3" or "2,5,8-10". When rtename shares data with a DataWindow, pagerange refers to pages based on the total number of pages in the control, not within each instance of the document.

params.name: collate
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want the copies collated. Values are: TRUE -- Collate copies FALSE -- Do not collate copies

params.name: canceldialog
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want to display a nonmodal dialog box that allows the user to cancel printing. Values are: TRUE -- Display the dialog box FALSE -- Do not display the dialog box

functions.name: PrintAsPDF
functions.documentation: Prints the current web page as a PDF file.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: PdfFile
params.description: The file path and file name of the PDF file to be saved.

functions.name: PrintBitmap
functions.documentation: Writes a bitmap at the specified location on the current page.
functions.syntax: PrintBitmap ( printjobnumber, bitmap, x, y, width, height )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job.

params.name: bitmap
params.description: A string whose value is the file name of the bitmap image.

params.name: x
params.description: An integer whose value is the x coordinate (in thousandths of an inch) on the page of the bitmap image.

params.name: y
params.description: An integer whose value is the y coordinate (in thousandths of an inch) on the page of the bitmap image.

params.name: width
params.description: The integer width of the bitmap image in thousandths of an inch. If width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the original width of the image.

params.name: height
params.description: The integer height of the bitmap image in thousandths of an inch. If height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the original height of the image.

functions.name: PrintCancel
functions.documentation: Cancels printing and deletes the spool file, if any. Cancels printing of a print job that you opened with the PrintOpen function. The print job is identified by the number returned by PrintOpen. For syntax for DataWindows and DataStores, see the PrintCancel method for DataWindows in the section called “PrintCancel” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

functions.name: PrintClose
functions.documentation: Sends the current page to the printer (or spooler) and closes the job. Call PrintClose as the last command of a print job unless PrintCancel function has closed the job.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

functions.name: PrintDataWindow
functions.documentation: Prints the contents of a DataWindow control or DataStore as a print job.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: dwcontrol
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, child DataWindow, or DataStore containing the DataWindow object you want to print

functions.name: PrintDefineFont
functions.documentation: Creates a numbered font definition that consists of a font supported by your printer and a set of font properties. You can use the font number in the PrintSetFont or PrintText functions. You can define up to eight fonts at a time.
functions.syntax: PrintDefineFont ( printjobnumber, fontnumber, facename, height, weight, fontpitch, fontfamily, italic, underline )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job.

params.name: fontnumber
params.description: The number (1 to 8) you want to assign to the font.

params.name: facename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of a typeface supported by your printer (for example, Courier 10Cpi).

params.name: height
params.description: An integer whose value is the height of the type in thousandths of an inch (for example, 250 for 18-point 10Cpi) or a negative number representing the point size (for example, -18 for 18-point). Specifying the point size is more exact; the height in thousandths of an inch only approximates the point size.

params.name: weight
params.description: The stroke weight of the type. Normal weight is 400 and bold is 700.

params.name: fontpitch
params.description: A value of the FontPitch enumerated datatype indicating the pitch of the font: Default! Fixed! Variable!

params.name: fontfamily
params.description: A value of the FontFamily enumerated datatype indicating the family of the font: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

params.name: italic
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether the font is italic. The default is false (not italic).

params.name: underline
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether the font is underlined. The default is false (not underlined).

functions.name: PrintEx
functions.documentation: Prints the contents of a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control whose contents you want to print.

params.name: canceldialog
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want to display a nonmodal Cancel dialog box that allows the user to cancel printing. The System Print dialog box always displays. Values are: TRUE -- Display the dialog box FALSE -- Do not display the dialog box

functions.name: PrintGetPrinter
functions.documentation: Gets the current printer name.

functions.name: PrintGetPrinters
functions.documentation: Gets the list of available printers.

functions.name: PrintLine
functions.documentation: Draws a line of a specified thickness between the specified endpoints on the current print page.
functions.syntax: PrintLine ( printjobnumber, x1, y1, x2, y2, thickness )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: x1
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the start of the line

params.name: y1
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the start of the line

params.name: x2
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the end of the line

params.name: y2
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the end of the line

params.name: thickness
params.description: An integer specifying the thickness of the line in thousandths of an inch

functions.name: PrintOpen
functions.documentation: Opens a print job and assigns it a number, which you use in other printing statements.

params.name: jobname
params.description: A string specifying a name for the print job. The name is displayed in the Windows Print Manager dialog box and in the Spooler dialog box.

params.name: showprintdialog
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want to display the system Print dialog box that allows the user to select a printer or set print properties. Values are: TRUE -- Display the dialog box FALSE -- (default) Do not display the dialog box

functions.name: PrintOval
functions.documentation: Draws a white oval outlined in a line of the specified thickness on the print page.
functions.syntax: PrintOval ( printjobnumber, x, y, width, height, thickness )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: x
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the oval's bounding box

params.name: y
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the oval's bounding box

params.name: width
params.description: An integer specifying the width in thousandths of an inch of the oval's bounding box

params.name: height
params.description: An integer specifying the height in thousandths of an inch of the oval's bounding box

params.name: thickness
params.description: An integer specifying the thickness of the line that outlines the oval in thousandths of an inch

functions.name: PrintPage
functions.documentation: Sends the current page to the printer or spooler and begins a new blank page in the current print job.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

functions.name: PrintRect
functions.documentation: Draws a white rectangle with a border of the specified thickness on the print page.
functions.syntax: PrintRect ( printjobnumber, x, y, width, height, thickness )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: x
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

params.name: y
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

params.name: width
params.description: An integer specifying the rectangle's width in thousandths of an inch

params.name: height
params.description: An integer specifying the rectangle's height in thousandths of an inch

params.name: thickness
params.description: An integer specifying the thickness of the rectangle's border line in thousandths of an inch

functions.name: PrintRoundRect
functions.documentation: Draws a white rectangle with rounded corners and a border of the specified thickness on the print page.
functions.syntax: PrintRoundRect ( printjobnumber, x, y, width, height, xradius, yradius, thickness )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: x
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

params.name: y
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

params.name: width
params.description: An integer specifying the rectangle's width in thousandths of an inch

params.name: height
params.description: An integer specifying the rectangle's height in thousandths of an inch

params.name: xradius
params.description: An integer specifying the x radius of the corner rounding

params.name: yradius
params.description: An integer specifying the y radius of the corner rounding

params.name: thickness
params.description: An integer specifying the thickness of the rectangle's border line in thousandths of an inch

functions.name: PrintScreen
functions.documentation: Prints the screen image as part of a print job.
functions.syntax: PrintScreen ( printjobnumber, x, y {, width, height } )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigns to the print job.

params.name: x
params.description: An integer whose value is the x coordinate on the page, in thousandths of an inch, of the upper-left corner of the screen image.

params.name: y
params.description: An integer whose value is the y coordinate on the page, in thousandths of an inch, of the upper-left corner of the screen image.

params.name: width
params.description: The integer width of the printed screen in thousandths of an inch. If you omit width, PowerBuilder prints the screen at its original width. If you specify width, you must also specify height.

params.name: height
params.description: The integer height of the printed screen in thousandths of an inch. If you omit height, PowerBuilder prints the screen at its original height.

functions.name: PrintSend
functions.documentation: Sends an arbitrary string of characters to the printer. PrintSend is usually used for sending escape sequences that change the printer's setup.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job.

params.name: string
params.description: A string you want to send to the printer. In the string, use ASCII values for nonprinting characters.

params.name: zerochar
params.description: An ASCII value (1 to 255) that you want to use to represent the number zero in string.

functions.name: PrintSetFont
functions.documentation: Designates a font to be used for text printed with the Print function. You specify the font by number. Use PrintDefineFont to associate a font number with the desired font, a size, and a set of properties.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: fontnumber
params.description: The number (1 to 8) of a font defined for the job in PrintDefineFont or 0 (the default font for the printer)

functions.name: PrintSetPrinter
functions.documentation: Sets the printer to use for the next print function call. This function does not affect open jobs.

params.name: printername
params.description: String for the name of the printer you want to use

functions.name: PrintSetSpacing
functions.documentation: Sets the factor that PowerBuilder uses to calculate line spacing.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job.

params.name: spacingfactor
params.description: The number by which you want to multiply the character height to determine the vertical line-to-line spacing. The default is 1.2.

functions.name: PrintSetup
functions.documentation: Calls the Printer Setup dialog box provided by the system printer driver and lets the user specify settings for the printer.

functions.name: PrintSetupPrinter
functions.documentation: Displays the printer setup dialog box

functions.name: PrintText
functions.documentation: Prints a single line of text starting at the specified coordinates.
functions.syntax: PrintText ( printjobnumber, string, x, y {, fontnumber } )

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job.

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose value is the text you want to print.

params.name: x
params.description: An integer specifying the x coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the beginning of the text.

params.name: y
params.description: An integer specifying the y coordinate in thousandths of an inch of the beginning of the text.

params.name: fontnumber
params.description: The number (1 to 8) of a font defined for the job by using the PrintDefineFont function or 0 (the default font for the printer). If you omit fontnumber, the text prints in the current font for the print job.

functions.name: PrintWidth
functions.documentation: Determines the width of a string using the current font of the specified print job.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose value is the text for which you want to determine the width

functions.name: PrintX
functions.documentation: Reports the x coordinate of the print cursor.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

functions.name: PrintY
functions.documentation: Reports the y coordinate of the print cursor.

params.name: printjobnumber
params.description: The number the PrintOpen function assigned to the print job

functions.name: ProfileInt
functions.documentation: Obtains the integer value of a setting in the profile file for your application.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the profile file. If you do not specify a full path, ProfileInt uses the operating system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: section
params.description: A string whose value is the name of a group of related values in the profile file. In the file, section names are in square brackets. Do not include the brackets in section. Section is not case sensitive.

params.name: key
params.description: A string specifying the setting name in section whose value you want. The setting name is followed by an equal sign in the file. Do not include the equal sign in key. Key is not case sensitive.

params.name: default
params.description: An integer value that ProfileInt will return if filename is not found, if section or key does not exist in filename, or if the value of key cannot be converted to an integer.

functions.name: ProfileString
functions.returnType: String, with a maximum length of 4096 characters
functions.documentation: Obtains the string value of a setting in the profile file for your application.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the profile file. If you do not specify a full path, ProfileString uses the operating system's standard file search order to find the file.

params.name: section
params.description: A string whose value is the name of a group of related values in the profile file. In the file, section names are in square brackets. Do not include the brackets in section. Section is not case sensitive.

params.name: key
params.description: A string specifying the setting name in section whose value you want. The setting name is followed by an equal sign in the file. Do not include the equal sign in key. Key is not case sensitive.

params.name: default
params.description: A string value that ProfileString will return if filename is not found, if section or key does not exist in filename, or if the value of key cannot be converted to an integer.

functions.name: Rand
functions.returnType: A numeric datatype, the datatype of n
functions.documentation: Obtains a random whole number between 1 and a specified upper limit.

params.name: n
params.description: The upper limit of the range of random numbers you want returned. The lower limit is always 1. The upper limit is 32,767.

functions.name: Randomize
functions.documentation: Initializes the random number generator so that the Rand function begins a new series of pseudorandom numbers.

params.name: n
params.description: The starting value (seed) for the random number generator. When n is 0, PowerBuilder takes the seed from the system clock and begins a nonrepeatable sequence. A nonzero number generates a different but repeatable sequence for each seed value. n cannot exceed 32,767.

functions.name: Read
functions.documentation: Reads data from an opened OLE stream object.

params.name: olestream
params.description: The name of an OLE stream variable that has been opened.

params.name: variable
params.description: The name of a string variable into which want to read data from olestream.

params.name: stopforline
params.description: A boolean value that specifies whether to read a line at a time. In other words, Read will stop reading at the next carriage return/linefeed. Values are: TRUE -- (Default) Stop at the end of a line and leave the read pointer positioned after the carriage return/linefeed so the next read will read the next line FALSE -- Read the whole stream or a maximum of 32,765 bytes

params.name: maximumread
params.description: A long value specifying the maximum number of bytes to be read. The default is 32,765 or the length of olestream.

functions.name: ReadData
functions.documentation: Reads the response body.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the HTTPClient object for which you want to read the response body.

params.name: data
params.description: A blob value into which the function returns data.

params.name: bufferSize
params.description: A long value specifying the buffer size.

functions.name: Real
functions.documentation: Converts a string value to a real datatype or obtains a real value that is stored in a blob.

params.name: stringorblob
params.description: The string whose value you want returned as a real value or a blob in which the first value is the real value. The rest of the contents of the blob is ignored. Stringorblob can also be an Any variable containing a string or blob.

functions.name: RecognizeText
functions.documentation: Specifies that text in an InkEdit control should be recognized.

params.name: inkeditname
params.description: The name of the InkEdit control in which you want to recognize text.

functions.name: Redo
functions.documentation: Restores the edit that was previously undone in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to restore the edit that was previously undone

functions.name: Refresh
functions.documentation: Refreshes the current Web page. This is similar to navigating to the URI of current top level document including all navigation events firing and respecting any entries in the HTTP cache. But, the back or forward history will not be modified.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

functions.name: RegisterEvent
functions.documentation: Registers the PowerBuilder user event so they can be triggered in JavaScript. For how to define and trigger the PowerBuilder user event, refer to Triggering PowerBuilder events in JavaScript .

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: eventName
params.description: The name of the user-defined event to be registered.

functions.name: RegisterObject
functions.documentation: Registers the PowerBuilder object. After registration, the event in the PowerBuilder object can be triggered by the PowerBuilder.RegisteredObject.TriggerEvent method in the .NET assembly. The event to be triggered by .NET assembly must be a custom event that can have only one string-type parameter or no parameter, with one string-type return value or no return value. For details, refer to Triggering PowerScript events from C# code in Application Techniques .
functions.syntax: Integer RegisterObject(readonly string objectname, PowerObject obj)

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name to be registered with the object. The user event in the registered object can be triggered by .NET assembly. The object name is case-sensitive.

params.name: obj
params.description: The PowerBuilder object to be registered.

functions.name: RegistryDelete
functions.documentation: Deletes a key or a value for a key in the Windows system registry.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value is the key in the system registry you want to delete or whose value you want to delete. To uniquely identify a key, specify the list of parent keys above it in the hierarchy, starting with the root key. The keys in the list are separated by backslashes.

params.name: valuename
params.description: A string containing the name of a value in the registry. If the specified key does not have a subkey, specifying an empty string deletes the key and its named values.

functions.name: RegistryGet
functions.documentation: Gets a value from the Windows system registry.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value names the key in the system registry whose value you want. To uniquely identify a key, specify the list of parent keys above it in the hierarchy, starting with the root key. The keys in the list are separated by backslashes.

params.name: valuename
params.description: A string containing the name of a value in the registry. Each key can have one unnamed value and several named values. For the unnamed value, specify an empty string.

params.name: valuetype
params.description: A value of the RegistryValueType enumerated datatype identifying the datatype of a value in the registry. Values are: RegString! -- A null-terminated string RegExpandString! -- A null-terminated string that contains unexpanded references to environment variables RegBinary! -- Binary data ReguLong! -- A 32-bit number ReguLongBigEndian! -- A 32-bit number RegLongLong! -- A 64-bit number which is the longlong type ranging from 0 - 9,223,372,036,854,775,807, because the registry key value cannot accept a negative number. RegLink! -- A Unicode symbolic link RegMultiString! -- An unbounded array of strings

params.name: valuevariable
params.description: A variable corresponding to the datatype of valuetype in which you want to store the value obtained from the system registry for the specified key and value name.

functions.name: RegistryKeys
functions.documentation: Obtains a list of the keys that are child items (subkeys) one level below a key in the Windows system registry.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value names the key in the system registry whose subkeys you want. To uniquely identify a key, specify the list of parent keys above it in the hierarchy, starting with the root key. The keys in the list are separated by backslashes.

params.name: subkeys
params.description: An array variable of strings in which you want to store the subkeys. If the array is variable size, its upper bound will reflect the number of subkeys found. If the array is fixed size, it must be large enough to hold all the subkeys. However, there will be no way to know how many subkeys were actually found.

functions.name: RegistrySet
functions.documentation: Sets the value for a key and value name in the system registry. If the key or value name does not exist, RegistrySet creates a new key or name and sets its value.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value names the key in the system registry whose value you want to set. To uniquely identify a key, specify the list of parent keys above it in the hierarchy, starting with the root key. The keys in the list are separated by backslashes. If key does not exist in the registry, RegistrySet creates a new key. To create a key without a named value, specify an empty string for valuename.

params.name: valuename
params.description: A string containing the name of a value in the registry. Each key may have several named values. To specify the unnamed value, specify an empty string. If valuename does not exist in the registry, RegistrySet causes a new name to be created for key.

params.name: valuetype
params.description: A value of the RegistryValueType enumerated datatype identifying the datatype of a value in the registry. Values are: RegString! -- A null-terminated string RegExpandString! -- A null-terminated string that contains unexpanded references to environment variables RegBinary! -- Binary data ReguLong! -- A 32-bit number ReguLongBigEndian! -- A 32-bit number RegLongLong! -- A 64-bit number which is the longlong type ranging from 0 - 9,223,372,036,854,775,807, because the registry key value cannot accept a negative number. RegLink! -- A Unicode symbolic link RegMultiString! -- An unbounded array of strings

params.name: value
params.description: A variable corresponding to the datatype of valuetype containing a value to be set in the registry.

functions.name: RegistryValues
functions.documentation: Obtains the list of named values associated with a key.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value is the key in the system registry for which you want the values of its subkeys. To uniquely identify a key, specify the list of parent keys above it in the hierarchy, starting with the root key. The keys in the list are separated by backslashes.

params.name: valuename
params.description: An array variable of strings in which you want to store the names. If the array is variable size, its upper bound will reflect the number of named values found. If the array is fixed size, it must be large enough to hold all the names. However, there will be no way to know how many names were actually found.

functions.name: RelativeDate
functions.documentation: Obtains the date that occurs a specified number of days after or before another date.

params.name: date
params.description: A value of type date

params.name: n
params.description: An integer indicating a number of days

functions.name: RelativeTime
functions.documentation: Obtains a time that occurs a specified number of seconds after or before another time within a 24-hour period.

params.name: time
params.description: A value of type time

params.name: n
params.description: A long number of seconds

functions.name: ReleaseAutomationNativePointer
functions.documentation: Releases the pointer to an OLE object that you got with GetAutomationNativePointer.

params.name: oleobject
params.description: The name of an OLEObject variable containing the object for which you want to release the native pointer.

params.name: pointer
params.description: A UnsignedLong variable that holds the pointer you want to release. ReleaseAutomationNativePointer sets pointer to 0 so that it is clearly no longer a valid pointer.

functions.name: ReleaseNativePointer
functions.documentation: Releases the pointer to an OLE object that you got with GetNativePointer.

params.name: olename
params.description: The name of the OLE control containing the object for which you want the native pointer.

params.name: pointer
params.description: A UnsignedLong variable that holds the pointer you want to release. ReleaseNativePointer sets pointer to 0 so that it is clearly no longer a valid pointer.

functions.name: Remove
functions.documentation: Removes a key. If more than one key with the same name exists, then remove the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner. Removes a radio button object from a PDFFormFieldRadioButtonGroup object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: Name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the PDFFormFieldRadioButton object.

params.name: radioButton
params.description: The name of the PDFFormFieldRadioButton object.

functions.name: RemoveAction
functions.documentation: Removes the action that is associated with the specified event.

params.name: actionEvent
params.description: The event that triggers the action. actionEvent is of the PDFFormFieldEvent data type, supporting these values: PDFFormFieldEvent_Up! PDFFormFieldEvent_Down! PDFFormFieldEvent_Enter! PDFFormFieldEvent_Exit!.

functions.name: RemoveAll
functions.documentation: Removes all the items in an object.

functions.name: RemoveAllAction
functions.documentation: Removes all the actions associated with the current object.

functions.name: RemoveAllFallbackFont
functions.documentation: Removes all fallback fonts.

functions.name: RemoveAllFormFieldGroup
functions.documentation: Removes all the form field groups (PDFFormFieldGroup object) in a PDF document.

functions.name: RemoveAllItem
functions.documentation: Removes all items.

functions.name: RemoveApplicationButton
functions.documentation: Removes the application button from the RibbonBar control.

functions.name: RemoveContent
functions.documentation: Removes a PDFContent object from a page (a PDFPage object).

params.name: Content
params.description: The name of the PDFContent object to be removed.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the PDFContent object to be removed.

functions.name: RemoveDirectory
functions.documentation: Removes a directory.

params.name: directoryname
params.description: String for the name of the directory you want to remove. If you do not specify an absolute path, this function deletes relative to the current working directory.

functions.name: RemoveFallbackFont
functions.documentation: Removes a fallback font.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the font.

params.name: fontName
params.description: The name of the font.

functions.name: RemoveFormFieldGroup
functions.documentation: Removes the form field group (PDFFormFieldGroup object) with the specified index in a PDF document.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the PDFFormFieldGroup object.

params.name: formFieldGroup
params.description: The PDFFormFieldGroup object.

functions.name: RemoveItem
functions.documentation: Removes a specified item.

params.name: item
params.description: The item to be removed from the table of contents.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the item to be removed from the table of contents. The indexes of the items in a table of contents are auto generated, and are structured by levels. For example, the level-1 chapters start their index at 1; and the sub-items in each chapter start their index at 1 too.

params.name: itemText
params.description: The text of the item to be removed.

functions.name: RemovePage
functions.documentation: Removes a page from the PDF document.

params.name: page
params.description: The PDFPage object to be removed from the document.

params.name: index
params.description: The page index in the PDF document at which the page shall be removed.

functions.name: RemoveTab
functions.documentation: Removes a tab stop in the RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control from which you want to remove the tab stop

params.name: tabcurrent
params.description: An integer indicating the order of the tab stop that you want to remove. Possible values are from 1 to 14.

functions.name: RemoveTextBlock
functions.documentation: Removes a PDFTextBlock object in the current PDFRichText object.

params.name: index
params.description: The PDFTextBlock object to be removed from the current PDFRichText object. The index of the objects are determined by the orders they are added, starting at 1. If one object is removed, the indexes of the remaining objects will be reordered.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the PDFTextBlock object to be removed. If there are multiple PDFTextBlock objects with the same name in the PDFRichText object, only the first one will be removed.

functions.name: RemoveWrapImage
functions.documentation: Removes an image that the current PDFRichText object wraps around.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the image that the PDFRichText object wraps around. The index of the images are determined by the orders the WrapImage function is called to wrap it, starting at 1. If the wrapping for one image is removed, the indexes of the remaining objects will be reordered.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the image that the PDFRichText object wraps around.

functions.name: Repair
functions.documentation: Updates the target database with corrections that have been made in the pipeline user object's Error DataWindow.

params.name: pipelineobject
params.description: The name of a pipeline user object that contains the pipeline object being executed

params.name: destinationtrans
params.description: The name of a transaction object with which to connect to the target database

functions.name: Replace
functions.documentation: Replaces a portion of one string with another.

params.name: string1
params.description: The string in which you want to replace characters with string2.

params.name: start
params.description: A long whose value is the number of the first character you want replaced. (The first character in the string is number 1.)

params.name: n
params.description: A long whose value is the number of characters you want to replace.

params.name: string2
params.description: The string that will replace characters in string1. The number of characters in string2 can be greater than, equal to, or less than the number of characters you are replacing.

functions.name: ReplaceA
functions.documentation: Temporarily converts a string to DBCS based on the current locale, then replaces a portion of one string with another.

params.name: string1
params.description: The string containing characters you want to replace.

params.name: start
params.description: A long whose value is the position in bytes of the first character you want to replace in string1.

params.name: n
params.description: A long whose value is the number of bytes you want to replace in string1.

params.name: string2
params.description: The string that will replace characters in string1. The number of characters in string2 can be greater than, equal to, or less than the number of characters you are replacing.

functions.name: ReplaceCategoryByJSON
functions.documentation: Replaces an existing category with the category from a JSON file.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle for the category item for which you want to replace.

params.name: data
params.description: The string of the category data in the required RibbonBar JSON format.

functions.name: ReplaceCategoryByXML
functions.documentation: Replaces an existing category with the category from an XML file.
functions.syntax: Integer controlname.ReplaceCategoryByXML ( long itemhandle, string data )

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle for the item for which you want to replace category.

params.name: data
params.description: The string of the category data in the required RibbonBar XML format. To ensure the format is correct, you can export the menu to an XML file and then modify the file according to your needs.

functions.name: ReplaceText
functions.returnType: Integer for DataWindow, InkEdit, and list boxes, Long for other controls
functions.documentation: Replaces selected text in an edit control with a specified string.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, EditMask, InkEdit, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, RichTextEdit, DropDownListBox, or DropDownPictureListBox control in which you want to replace the selected string. In a DataWindow control, the text is replaced in the edit control over the current row and column.

params.name: string
params.description: The string that replaces the selected text.

functions.name: ReplaceW
functions.documentation: Replaces a portion of one string with another. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Replace in all environments.

functions.name: RequestResource
functions.documentation: Sends a request to get resource.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the OAuthClient object.

params.name: oAuthRequest
params.description: A reference to the OAuthRequest object specifying the request information.

params.name: resourceResponse
params.description: A reference to the ResourceResponse object into which the function returns the object.

functions.name: ResendPostRequest
functions.documentation: Sends the request again. The function is called when both of the following conditions are met:

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object from which you want to resend the request.

functions.name: Reset
functions.documentation: Clears data from a control or object. The syntax you choose depends on the target object. For syntax for DataWindows and DataStores, see the Reset method for DataWindows in the section called “Reset” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: listboxname
params.description: The name of the ListBox control from which to delete all items

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph object in which you want to delete all the data values or all series and all data values

params.name: graphresettype
params.description: A value of the grResetType enumerated datatype specifying whether you want to delete only data values or all series and all data values: All! -- Delete all series, categories, and data in controlname Category! -- Delete categories and data in controlname Data! -- Delete data in controlname Series! -- Delete the series and data in controlname

params.name: instancename
params.description: Instance name of the TraceFile object

params.name: mimemessage
params.description: A MimeMessage object identifying the email message in which you want to reset MimeMessage information.

params.name: resettype
params.description: Specifies the values of the reset type. Values are: 0 -- (Default) Reset all 1 -- Reset Recipients 2 -- Reset Cc 3 -- Reset Bcc 4 -- Reset Attachments 5 -- Reset LinkedResources 6 -- Reset Sender 7 -- Reset ReplyTo

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the BatchDataObjects object.

functions.name: ResetArgElements
functions.documentation: Clears the argument list.

params.name: activexcontrol
params.description: Identifier for the instance of the PowerBuilder window ActiveX control. When used in HTML, this is the NAME attribute of the object element. When used in other environments, this references the control that contains the PowerBuilder window ActiveX.

functions.name: ResetDataColors
functions.documentation: Restores the color of a data point to the default color for its series.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph in which you want to reset the color of a data point, or the name of the DataWindow containing the graph

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control in which you want to reset the color

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number of the series in which you want to reset the color of a data point

params.name: datapointnumber
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to reset the color

functions.name: ResetInk
functions.documentation: Clears ink from an InkPicture control.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to clear ink.

functions.name: ResetPicture
functions.documentation: Clears a picture from an InkPicture control.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to clear a picture.

functions.name: Resize
functions.documentation: Resizes an object or control by setting its Width and Height properties and then redraws the object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object or control you want to resize

params.name: width
params.description: The new width in PowerBuilder units

params.name: height
params.description: The new height in PowerBuilder units

functions.name: RespondRemote
functions.documentation: Sends a DDE message indicating whether the command or data received from a remote DDE application was acceptable.

params.name: boolean
params.description: A boolean expression. true indicates that the previously received command or data was acceptable. false indicates that it was not.

functions.name: Restart
functions.documentation: Stops the execution of all scripts, closes all windows (without executing the scripts for the Close events), commits and disconnects from the database, restarts the application, and executes the application-level script for the Open event.

functions.name: ResumeDownload
functions.documentation: Resumes the download progress of the file.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: ItemId
params.description: The ID used to identify the file. The minimum value is 1. ItemId should be the return value of DownloadingStart or DownloadingStateChanged event.

functions.name: Retrieve
functions.documentation: Retrieves data to the DataWindow, DataWindowChild, or DataStore from the RESTFul Web service according to the key name of the JSON string. If the data received from the RESTful web service is compressed, it will be automatically decompressed. Gzip and Brotli compression formats are supported. The developer can use the SetRequestHeader function to set the Accept-Encoding header to allow only the gzip or br compression format.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the RestClient object.

params.name: dwControl
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, DataStore, or child DataWindow.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string whose value is the URL.

params.name: data
params.description: A string or blob data. If this argument is not specified, the retrieve function sends the request to the server with "GET" method, otherwise with "POST".

params.name: tokenrequest
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object for supporting OAuth 2.0. If this parameter is used, the token settings in the SetOAuthToken and SetJWTToken functions will be ignored.

functions.name: RetrieveOne
functions.documentation: Retrieves one data row to the DataWindow, DataWindowChild, or DataStore from the RESTFul Web service. If the data received from the RESTful web service is compressed, it will be automatically decompressed. Gzip and Brotli compression formats are supported. The developer can use the SetRequestHeader function to set the Accept-Encoding header to allow only the gzip or br compression format. It is NOT supported to use this method to process large data (20 MB or 100,000 data rows can be considered as large data based on our tests).

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the RestClient object.

params.name: dwObject
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, DataStore, or child DataWindow.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string whose value is the URL.

params.name: data
params.description: A string specifying the data to send to the server. If this argument is not specified, the RetrieveOne function sends the request to the server with "GET" method, otherwise with "POST".

functions.name: RetrieveOrUpdateWithModels
functions.documentation: Retrieves or updates data for more than one DataWindow, DataWindowChild, or DataStore using the .NET DataStore Web API. Commit changes to the database automatically if all succeed; otherwise roll back all of the changes if any DataWindow failed.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the RestClient object.

params.name: batchdataobjects
params.description: The object which contains one or more DataWindow controls, DataStores, and child DataWindows to be retrieved or updated.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string whose value is the URL of the .NET DataStore Web API.

params.name: tokenrequest
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object for supporting OAuth 2.0. If this parameter is used, the token settings in the SetOAuthToken and SetJWTToken functions will be ignored.

functions.name: RetrieveWithModel
functions.documentation: Retrieves data for one DataWindow, DataWindowChild, or DataStore using the .NET DataStore Web API.
functions.syntax: objectname.RetrieveWithModel (dwControl, urlName {, tokenrequest} {, param1, param2, param3…})

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the RestClient object.

params.name: dwControl
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, DataStore, or child DataWindow.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string whose value is the URL of the .NET DataStore Web API.

params.name: tokenrequest
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object for supporting OAuth 2.0. If this parameter is used, the token settings in the SetOAuthToken and SetJWTToken functions will be ignored.

params.name: param
params.description: One or more values that you want to use as retrieval arguments in the SQL SELECT statement defined in dwcontrol. (it can be an array)

functions.name: Reverse
functions.documentation: Reverses the order or characters in a string.

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose characters you want to reorder so that the last character is first and the first character is last.

functions.name: RevertToSelf
functions.documentation: Restores the security attributes for a COM object that is running on COM+ and impersonating the client.

params.name: transactionserver
params.description: Reference to the TransactionServer service instance

functions.name: RGB
functions.documentation: Calculates the long value that represents the color specified by numeric values for the red, green, and blue components of the color.

params.name: red
params.description: The integer value of the red component of the desired color

params.name: green
params.description: The integer value of the green component of the desired color

params.name: blue
params.description: The integer value of the blue component of the desired color

functions.name: Right
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from the end of a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string from which you want characters returned

params.name: n
params.description: A long whose value is the number of characters you want returned from the right end of string

functions.name: RightA
functions.documentation: Temporarily converts a string from Unicode to DBCS based on the current locale, then returns the specified number of bytes from the end of the string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to search

params.name: n
params.description: A long whose value is the number of bytes you want returned from the right end of string

functions.name: RightTrim
functions.documentation: Removes spaces from the end of a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want returned with trailing blanks deleted

params.name: removeallspaces
params.description: A boolean indicating that all types of spaces should be deleted

functions.name: RightTrimW
functions.documentation: Removes spaces from the end of a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as RightTrim in all environments.

functions.name: RightW
functions.documentation: Obtains a specified number of characters from the end of a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Right in all environments.

functions.name: Round
functions.documentation: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places.

params.name: x
params.description: The number you want to round.

params.name: n
params.description: The number of decimal places to which you want to round x. Valid values are 0 through 30.

functions.name: RoutineList
functions.documentation: Provides a list of the routines included in a performance analysis model.

params.name: instancename
params.description: Instance name of the ProfileClass or Profiling object.

params.name: list
params.description: An unbounded array variable of datatype ProfileRoutine in which RoutineList stores a ProfileRoutine object for each routine that exists in the model within a class. This argument is passed by reference.

functions.name: Run
functions.documentation: Runs the specified application program.

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose value is the file name of the program you want to execute. Optionally, string can contain one or more parameters for the program.

params.name: windowstate
params.description: A value of the WindowState enumerated datatype indicating the state in which you want to run the program: Maximized! -- Maximized; enlarge the program window to its maximum size when it starts Minimized! -- Minimized; shrink the program window to an icon when it starts Normal! -- (Default) Run the program window in its normal size

functions.name: Save
functions.documentation: Saves a picture and optionally overlay ink to a file or blob from an InkPicture control or saves an OLE object in an OLE control or an OLE storage object in syntax 1 and syntax 2. The syntax you use depends on the type of object you want to save. Saves the contents to a PDF document in syntax 3.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to save a picture.

params.name: t
params.description: A string containing the name and location of the file into which the picture will be saved.

params.name: b
params.description: The name of a blob passed by reference that will hold the picture in the control.

params.name: format
params.description: An integer specifying the format in which the picture is to be saved. Values are: 0 -- BMP (bitmap) 1 -- JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group) 2 -- GIF (Graphics Interchange Format) 3 -- TIFF (Tagged Image File Format) 4 -- PNG (Portable Network Graphics)

params.name: WithInk
params.description: A boolean specifying whether overlay ink should be saved with the picture. Values are: True -- overlay ink is saved with the picture (default) False -- overlay ink is not saved with the picture

params.name: oleobject
params.description: The name of an OLE control or an OLE storage variable

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the PDFDocument object in which you want to save the contents to a PDF document.

params.name: fileName
params.description: The name of the PDF document to be saved (including the file path).

params.name: pdfData
params.description: The Blob variable where the content of the PDF document will be saved.

params.name: standard
params.description: The PDFStandard is the enumerated data type indicating the level of PDF/A conformance. Values are: PDF_None! (Default) PDFA_1a! PDFA_1b! PDFA_3a! PDFA_3b! PDFA_3u! PDF_Unknown!

functions.name: SaveAs
functions.documentation: Saves the contents of a DataWindow, DataStore, graph, OLE control, or OLE storage in a file. The syntax you use depends on the type of object you want to save. For DataWindow and DataStore syntax, see the SaveAs method for DataWindows in the section called “SaveAs” in DataWindow Reference .
functions.syntax: controlname.SaveAs ( { filename, } { graphcontrol, saveastype, colheading { , encoding } } )

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph control whose contents you want to save or the name of the DataWindow DataStore containing the graph.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file in which you want to save the data in the graph. If you omit filename or specify an empty string (""), PowerBuilder prompts the user for a file name.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control or DataStore whose contents you want to save.

params.name: saveastype
params.description: A value of the SaveAsType enumerated datatype specifying the format in which to save the data represented in the graph. Values are: Clipboard! -- Save an image of the graph to the clipboard CSV! -- Comma-separated values dBASE2! -- dBASE-II format dBASE3! -- dBASE-III format DIF! -- Data Interchange Format EMF! -- Enhanced Metafile Format Excel! -- Microsoft Excel format Excel5! -- Microsoft Excel version 5 format Excel8! -- Microsoft Excel version 8 and higher format HTMLTable! -- HTML TABLE, TR, and TD elements PDF! -- Adobe Portable Document Format PSReport! -- Powersoft Report (PSR) format SQLInsert! -- SQL syntax SYLK! -- Microsoft Multiplan format Text! -- (Default) Tab-separated columns with a return at the end of each row WKS! -- Lotus 1-2-3 format WK1! -- Lotus 1-2-3 format WMF! -- Windows Metafile Format XLSB! -- Excel format for binary data XLSX! -- Excel format for XML data XML! -- Extensible Markup Language XSLFO! -- Extensible Stylesheet Language Formatting Objects Obsolete values The following SaveAsType values are considered obsolete and will be removed in a future release: Excel!, WK1!, WKS!, SYLK!, dBase2!, WMF!. Use Excel8!, XLSB!, or XLSX! for current versions of Microsoft Excel! and EMF! in place of WMF!.

params.name: colheading
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want column headings with the saved data. The default value is true. Colheading is ignored for dBASE files; column headings are always saved.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Character encoding of the file to which the data is saved. This parameter applies only to the following formats: TEXT, CSV, SQL, HTML, and DIF. If you do not specify an encoding parameter, the file is saved in ANSI format. Values are: EncodingANSI! (default) EncodingUTF8! EncodingUTF16LE! EncodingUTF16BE!

params.name: olecontrol
params.description: The name of the OLE control containing the object you want to save.

params.name: OLEtargetfile
params.description: A string specifying the name of an OLE storage file. The file can already exist. OLEtargetfile can include a path, as well as information about where to store the object in the file's internal structure.

params.name: targetstorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of OLEStorage in which to store the object in olecontrol.

params.name: substoragename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of a substorage within targetstorage. If substorage does not exist, SaveAs creates it.

params.name: olestorage
params.description: The name of an object variable of type OLEStorage containing the OLE object you want to save.

functions.name: SaveDockingState
functions.documentation: Stores the MDI state in the registry.

params.name: regkey
params.description: The regkey argument is the registry key. If no entry for the key exists in the registry, one is created. Existing keys are overwritten.

functions.name: SaveDocument
functions.documentation: Saves the contents of a RichTextEdit control in a file. You can specify either rich-text format (RTF) or text format for the file.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control whose contents you want to save.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file to be saved. If the file already exists, the FileExists event is triggered.

params.name: filetype
params.description: A value of the FileType enumerated datatype specifying the format of the saved file. Values are: FileTypeRichText! -- Save the file in rich text format FileTypeText! -- Save the file as text FileTypeDoc! -- Save the file in Microsoft Word format FileTypeHTML! -- Save the file in HTML format FileTypePDF! -- Save the file in PDF format

params.name: encoding
params.description: Character encoding of the file to which the data is saved. This parameter applies only to text files. If you do not specify an encoding parameter, the file is saved in ANSI format. The filetype argument must be set to FileTypeText! If the filetype argument is set to any other file type, this argument is ignored. Values are: EncodingANSI! (default) EncodingUTF8! EncodingUTF16LE! EncodingUTF16BE!

functions.name: SaveDocumentAsPDF
functions.documentation: Saves the contents in a RichTextEdit control as a PDF document.
functions.syntax: rtename.SaveDocumentAsPDF(string filePathName{, string standard{, string userPassword, string masterPassword{, string restrictions}}})

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to save the contents as a PDF document.

params.name: filePathName
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the document to be saved (including the file path). Make sure you have write permission to the directory specified by the filePathName argument. Otherwise, the document will fail to be saved or be saved in %LocalAppData%\VirtualStore (the behavior of OS).

params.name: standard
params.description: The format indicating the level of PDF conformance. Values are: "0" -- PDF (default) "1" -- PDF/A-1a (not supported yet) "2" -- PDF/A-1b "3" -- PDF/A-3a (not supported yet) "4" -- PDF/A-3b (not supported yet) "5" -- PDF/A-3u (not supported yet) Note: Only the values of "0" and "2" are supported now.

params.name: userPassword
params.description: A password that enables you to open the generated PDF document. The userPassword argument can be set as an empty string, so you can open the document without any password. If userPassword is a non-empty string, you must also set masterPassword as a non-empty string. The user password and the master password cannot be the same, otherwise this function will fail.

params.name: masterPassword
params.description: A password that enables you to restrict the permissions of the generated PDF document. You can set the permissions by the restrictions argument. If masterPassword is an empty string, the restrictions argument will be ignored and no actions (copy/print/edit/etc.) will be restricted.

params.name: restrictions
params.description: The permission settings that enable you to restrict certain actions (such as copying/printing/editing) of a PDF document. One or more of the following string values can be contained (multiple strings are separated by ","). You can set the restrictions argument as an empty string. In this case, if masterPassword is valid, all permissions will be restricted, and if the masterPassword is invalid, the permissions will not be restricted. noprint! -- Acrobat will prevent printing the file. nohiresprint! -- Acrobat will prevent high-resolution printing. If noprint is not set, printing is restricted to the print as image feature which prints a low-resolution rendition of the page. nomodify! -- Acrobat will prevent editing or cropping pages and creating or changing form fields. noassemble! -- Acrobat will prevent inserting, deleting, or rotating pages and creating bookmarks and thumbnails. noannots! -- Acrobat will prevent creating or changing annotations and form fields. noforms! -- Acrobat will prevent form field filling. (implies nomodify and noannots) nocopy! -- Acrobat will prevent copying and extracting text or graphics; the accessibility interface will be controlled by noaccessible. noaccessible! -- (Obsolete in PDF 2.0; not allowed in PDF/UA-1) Acrobat will prevent extracting text or graphics for accessibility Note: If standard is set to "2" - PDF/A-1b, the three arguments ( userPassword , masterPassword , restrictions ) will be ignored. The PDF document will be saved using PDF/A-1b standard and will be opened without any password.

functions.name: SaveInk
functions.documentation: Saves ink to a file or blob from an InkPicture control.

params.name: inkpicname
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to save ink.

params.name: t
params.description: A string containing the name and location of a file that will hold the ink you want to save from the control.

params.name: b
params.description: The name of a blob passed by reference that will hold the ink you want to save from the control.

params.name: format
params.description: A value of the InkPersistenceFormat enumerated variable that specifies the format in which you want to save the ink. Values are: Base64GIFFormat! Base64InkSerializedFormat! GIFFormat! InkSerializedFormat! (default)

params.name: mode
params.description: A value of the InkCompressionMode enumerated variable that specifies the compression mode in which you want to save the ink. Values are: DefaultCompression! (default) MaximumCompression! NoCompression!

functions.name: SaveToFile
functions.documentation: Saves the JSON data to the local file.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONGenerator or JSONPackage object whose data you want to save to the file.

params.name: FileName
params.description: A string whose value is the file full name.

params.name: e
params.description: Character encoding of the resulting blob. Values are: EncodingANSI!, EncodingUTF8!, EncodingUTF16LE! (default), and EncodingUTF16BE!.

functions.name: Scroll
functions.documentation: Scrolls a multiline edit control or the edit control of a DataWindow a specified number of lines up or down.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, RichTextEdit, or MultiLineEdit in which you want to scroll up or down. If editname is a DataWindow, then Scroll affects its edit control.

params.name: number
params.description: A long specifying the direction and number of lines you want to scroll. To scroll down, use a positive long value. To scroll up, use a negative long value.

functions.name: ScrollNextPage
functions.documentation: Scrolls to the next page of the document in a RichTextEdit control or RichTextEdit DataWindow. For DataWindow syntax, see the ScrollNextPage method for DataWindows in the section called “ScrollNextPage” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit or DataWindow control in which you want to scroll to the next page. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

functions.name: ScrollNextRow
functions.documentation: Scrolls to the next instance of the document in a RichTextEdit control or RichTextEdit DataWindow. A RichTextEdit control has multiple instances of its document when it shares data with a DataWindow. The next instance of the document is associated with the next row in the DataWindow. For syntax specific to DataWindow controls and child DataWindows, see the ScrollNextRow method for DataWindows in the section called “ScrollNextRow” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit or DataWindow control in which you want to scroll to the next document instance. Each instance is associated with a DataWindow row. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

functions.name: ScrollPriorPage
functions.documentation: Scrolls to the prior page of the document in a RichTextEdit control or RichTextEdit DataWindow. For syntax specific to DataWindow controls and child DataWindows, see the ScrollPriorPage method for DataWindows in the section called “ScrollPriorPage” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit or DataWindow control in which you want to scroll to the prior page. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

functions.name: ScrollPriorRow
functions.documentation: Scrolls to the prior instance of the document in a RichTextEdit control or RichTextEdit DataWindow. A RichTextEdit control has multiple instances of its document when it shares data with a DataWindow. The next instance of the document is associated with the next row in the DataWindow. For syntax specific to DataWindow controls and child DataWindows, see the ScrollPriorRow method for DataWindows in the section called “ScrollPriorRow” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit or DataWindow control in which you want to scroll to the prior document instance. Each instance is associated with a DataWindow row. The DataWindow object in the DataWindow control must be a RichTextEdit DataWindow.

functions.name: ScrollToRow
functions.documentation: Scrolls to the document instance associated with the specified row when the RichTextEdit controls shares data with a DataWindow. For syntax specific to DataWindow controls and child DataWindows, see the ScrollToRow method for DataWindows in the section called “ScrollToRow” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to scroll to a document instance associated with the specified row.

params.name: row
params.description: A long identifying the row to which you want to scroll. If row, is 0, ScrollToRow scrolls to the first row. If row is greater than the number of rows in the associated DataWindow, it scrolls to the last row.

functions.name: SearchObject
functions.documentation: Gets an object by its name in the PDF document..

params.name: objectName
params.description: The name of the object to search in the PDF document.

functions.name: Second
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of seconds in the seconds portion of a time value.

params.name: time
params.description: The time value from which you want the seconds

functions.name: SecondsAfter
functions.documentation: Determines the number of seconds one time occurs after another.

params.name: time1
params.description: A time value that is the start time of the interval being measured

params.name: time2
params.description: A time value that is the end time of the interval

functions.name: Seek
functions.documentation: Moves the file pointer in an OLE stream object or displays a specified frame in an AVI clip in an animation control.

params.name: olestream
params.description: The name of an OLE stream variable that has been opened.

params.name: position
params.description: A long whose value is the position relative to origin to which you want to move the read/write pointer.

params.name: origin
params.description: The value of the SeekType enumerated datatype specifying where you want to start the seek. Values are: FromBeginning! -- (Default) At the beginning of the file FromCurrent! -- At the current position FromEnd! -- At the end of the file

params.name: animationname
params.description: The name of animation control displaying the AVI clip

params.name: s
params.description: A long value in the range 0 to 65,535 indicating the frame to display

functions.name: SelectedColumn
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of the character column just after the insertion point in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit in which you want the number of the character after the insertion point

functions.name: SelectedIndex
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of the selected item in a ListBox, ListView, or RibbonComboBoxItem control.

params.name: listcontrolname
params.description: The name of the ListBox, ListView, or RibbonComboBoxItem control in which you want to locate the selected item

functions.name: SelectedItem
functions.documentation: Obtains the text of the selected item in a ListBox control.

params.name: listboxname
params.description: The name of the ListBox or PictureListBox in which you want the text of the currently selected item

functions.name: SelectedLength
functions.returnType: Integer for DataWindow, InkEdit, and list boxes, Long for other controls
functions.documentation: Determines the total number of characters in the selected text in an editable control, including spaces and line endings.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, EditMask, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, RichTextEdit, DropDownListBox, or DropDownPictureListBox control in which you want the length of the selected text. For a DataWindow, it reports the length of the selected text in the edit control over the current row and column.

functions.name: SelectedLine
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of the line that contains the insertion point in an editable control. The insertion point moves to the next line if the current line contains a carriage return.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, MultiLineEdit, or RichTextEdit in which you want the number of the line containing the insertion point. For a DataWindow, it reports the line number in the edit control over the current row and column.

functions.name: SelectedPage
functions.documentation: Obtains the number of the current page in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want the number of the current page

functions.name: SelectedStart
functions.documentation: Reports the position of the first selected character in an editable control.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, EditMask, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, RichTextEdit, DropDownListBox, or DropDownPictureListBox control in which you want to determine the starting position of selected text. For a DataWindow, it reports the starting position in the edit control over the current row and column.

functions.name: SelectedText
functions.documentation: Obtains the selected text in an editable control.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow, EditMask, MultiLineEdit, SingleLineEdit, RichTextEdit, DropDownListBox, or DropDownPictureListBox control from which you want the selected text. For a DropDownListBox or DropDownPictureListBox, the AllowEdit property must be true. For a DataWindow, it reports the selected text in the edit control over the current row and column.

functions.name: SelectionRange
functions.documentation: Highlights a range of contiguous values in a trackbar control. The range you select is highlighted in the trackbar channel, with an arrow at each end of the range.

params.name: control
params.description: The name of the trackbar control

params.name: startpos
params.description: An integer that specifies the starting position of the range

params.name: endpos
params.description: An integer that specifies the ending position of the range

functions.name: SelectItem
