functions.name: SendDeleteRequest
functions.documentation: Sends the HTTP DELETE request to the server and then gets the content of the server response. It does not parse the HTTP response code and content of the server response. It is NOT supported to use this method to process large data (20 MB or 100,000 data rows can be considered as large data based on our tests).
functions.syntax: objectname.SendDeleteRequest(string urlName{, string data }, ref string response)

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the RESTClient object from which you want to send the request.

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string value specifying the URL.

params.name: data
params.description: A string value specifying the data to send. If the user sets the encoding charset in the Content-Type request header, this function will encode the data with the specified charset; if charset is not specified, this function will encode the data in UTF-8 by default.

params.name: response
params.description: The content of the server response. If RESTClient failed to send request or server provides no response, the response value is an empty string. If the response value is compressed, it will be automatically decompressed. Gzip and Brotli compression formats are supported. If the server specified the Content-Type response header, and in which the encoding charset is specified, this function will encode the data with the specified charset; if charset is not specified, this function will encode the data in UTF-8 by default.

params.description: A value of the LanguageID enumerated datatype specifying the language you have used for automation commands. The OLE server must have function and property names defined in the language you specify. Some values of LanguageID are: LanguageNeutral! -- No language is assumed. Automation commands match the server's default command set. LanguageUserDefault! -- The language locale is taken from the user's settings in the International control panel. LanguageSystemDefault! -- The language locale is taken from the version of Windows that is installed on the user's machine. You can also specify a language or dialect, such as LanguagePolish! or LanguagePortuguese_Brazilian! For the list of language-specific values for LanguageID, use the PowerBuilder Browser.

params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to set the color.

params.name: colortype
params.description: A value of the grColorType enumerated datatype specifying the aspect of the data point for which you want to set the color. Values are: Foreground! -- Text color Background! -- Background color LineColor! -- Line color Shade! -- Shade (for graphics that are three-dimensional or have solid objects)

params.name: color
params.description: A long whose value is the new color for colortype.

params.name: linestyle
params.description: A value of the LineStyle enumerated datatype. Values are: Continuous! Dash! DashDot! DashDotDot! Dot! Transparent!

params.name: linewidth
params.description: An integer whose value is the width of the line in pixels.

params.name: enumvalue
params.description: An enumerated datatype specifying the appearance setting for the data point. You can specify a FillPattern or grSymbolType value. To change the fill pattern, use a FillPattern value: Bdiagonal! -- Lines from lower left to upper right Diamond! Fdiagonal! -- Lines from upper left to lower right Horizontal! Solid! Square! Vertical! To change the symbol type, use a grSymbolType value: NoSymbol! SymbolHollowBox! SymbolX! SymbolStar! SymbolHollowUpArrow! SymbolHollowCircle! SymbolHollowDiamond! SymbolSolidDownArrow! SymbolSolidUpArrow! SymbolSolidCircle! SymbolSolidDiamond! SymbolPlus! SymbolHollowDownArrow! SymbolSolidBox!

functions.name: SetDataTransparency
functions.documentation: Sets the transparency percentage of a data point in a series in a DirectX 3D graph (those with 3D rendering).

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the graph in which you want to set data, or the name of the DataWindow control containing the graph.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control in which you want to set the transparency value of a data point.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series in which you want to set data.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to set a transparency value.

params.name: transparency
params.description: Integer value for percent transparency. A value of 0 means that the data point is opaque and a value of 100 means that it is completely transparent.

functions.name: SetDateLimits
functions.documentation: Sets the maximum and minimum date limits for the calendar.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the MonthCalendar control for which you want to set the date limits

params.name: min
params.description: A date value to be set as the minimum date that can be referenced or displayed in the calendar

params.name: max
params.description: A date value to be set as the maximum date that can be referenced or displayed in the calendar

functions.name: SetDropHighlight
functions.documentation: Highlights the specified item as the drop target.

params.name: treeviewname
params.description: The TreeView control in which you want to highlight an item as the target of a drag-and-drop operation

params.name: itemhandle
params.description: The handle of the item you want to highlight as the target in a drag-and-drop operation

functions.name: SetDynamicParm
functions.documentation: Specifies a value for an input parameter in the DynamicDescriptionArea that is used in an SQL OPEN or EXECUTE statement.

params.name: DynamicDescriptionArea
params.description: The name of the DynamicDescriptionArea, usually SQLDA.

params.name: index
params.description: An integer identifying the input parameter descriptor in which you want to set the data. Index must be less than or equal to the value in NumInputs in DynamicDescriptionArea.

params.name: value
params.description: The value you want to use to fill the input parameter descriptor identified by index.

functions.name: SetFirstVisible
functions.documentation: Sets the specified item as the first visible item in a TreeView control.

params.name: treeviewname
params.description: The TreeView control in which you want to identify an item as the first visible item

params.name: itemhandle
params.description: The handle of the item you are identifying as the first visible item in the TreeView control

functions.name: SetFocus
functions.documentation: Sets the focus on the specified object or control.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object or control in which you want to set the focus

functions.name: SetFont
functions.documentation: Sets the font to use for the title or item in the table of contents.

functions.name: SetGroup
functions.documentation: Sets the group for the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle of the group on the same level that you will set.

params.name: Item
params.description: A group item you are setting.

functions.name: SetHeader
functions.documentation: Sets the request header. If SetHeader or SetHeaders is not used to set the header for Authorization, the program will automatically set the header for Authorization and Content-type. Sets the request header.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object in which you want to set the request header.

params.name: headerName
params.description: A string specifying the header name.

params.name: headerValue
params.description: A string specifying the header value.

functions.name: SetHeaders
functions.documentation: Sets the header information of all requests. If SetHeader or SetHeaders is not used to set the header for Authorization, the program will automatically set the header for Authorization and Content-type. Sets the header information of all requests.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object in which you want to set the request header.

params.name: headers
params.description: A string specifying all of the header names.

functions.name: SetHeight
functions.documentation: Sets the height of the PDF page.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the page of the PDFPage object. The unit is point (pt).

functions.name: SetHighDPIMode
functions.documentation: Sets the DPI (Dots Per Inch) awareness mode.

params.name: applicationname
params.description: The name of the application object in which you want to set the DPI mode.

params.name: HighDpiMode
params.description: An integer determines the DPI awareness mode to be used in the application. 0 - None. If a PowerBuilder application is upgraded from an earlier version, it will be set to 0 by default. 1 - DpiUnaware. This is the default behavior in Windows. For the time being, it has the same effect as 0. 2 - SystemAwareness 3 - PerMonitor 4 (Default) - PerMonitorV2. If a new PowerBuilder application is created from scratch, it will be set to 4 by default. 5 - DpiUnawareGdiScaled For details about the awareness mode, refer to https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/hidpi/high-dpi-desktop-application-development-on-windows and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/hidpi/dpi-awareness-context .

functions.name: SetHttpRequestHeader
functions.documentation: Sets the HTTP request header. This function is only used for PowerServer and the request header that is set using this function is used only when PowerServer API calls are being made.
functions.syntax: applicationname.SetHttpRequestHeader ( string headerName, string headerValue{, Boolean replace } )

params.name: applicationname
params.description: The name of the application object in which you want to set the request header.

params.name: headerName
params.description: A string whose value is the header name.

params.name: headerValue
params.description: A string whose value is the header value.

params.name: replace
params.description: A boolean determines whether to replace the current existing request value if the same header name already exists. TRUE -- to replace the value in the current existing request header if the same header name already exists. FALSE -- to add the value (with a ",") to the current existing request header if the same header name already exists. The default value is FALSE. Note: use this argument cautiously 1) TRUE is recommended when you specify the charset in the "Content-Type" header, because no more than one charset is allowed; 2) FALSE is recommended when cookie is used.

functions.name: SetItem
functions.documentation: Sets the value of an item in a list. For use with DataWindows and DataStores, see the SetItem method for DataWindows in the section called “SetItem” in DataWindow Reference .

params.name: listviewname
params.description: The ListView for which you are setting item properties

params.name: index
params.description: The index number of the item for which you are setting properties

params.name: column
params.description: The index number of the column of the item for which you want to set properties

params.name: item
params.description: The ListViewItem variable containing property values you want to assign to a ListView item

params.name: label
params.description: The string value or variable which you are assigning to the specified column of the specified ListView item

params.name: treeviewname
params.description: The name of the TreeView control in which you want to set the data for a specific item

params.name: itemhandle
params.description: The handle associated with the item you want to change

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonMenu control in which you want to set the menu item.

params.name: ParentIndex
params.description: The index of the menu item (RibbonMenuItem) whose submenu item you want to set. If not specified, the menu item will be set; if specified to a valid value, the submenu item of the menu item (whose index is ParentIndex) will be set; if specified to an invalid value, an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

functions.name: SetItemList
functions.documentation: Adds a list of items to the object. Note that if you execute this function, the previous items will be cleared from the object, and then the new list of items will be added.

params.name: itemTextList[]
params.description: The list of items.

functions.name: SetJWTToken
functions.documentation: Sets the JWT token string to the HTTP request header which will be sent to the server in the following interface: Submit , SendGetRequest , SendPostRequest , SendDeleteRequest , SendPatchRequest , SendPutRequest , Retrieve , and RetrieveOne . If a token has been set in the HTTP request header, it will replace the original token.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the RESTClient object in which you want to set the JWT token.

params.name: jwtToken
params.description: A string value specifying the JWT token.

functions.name: SetLargeButton
functions.documentation: Sets the large button for the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle of the large button on the same level that you will set.

params.name: Item
params.description: A large button item you are setting.

functions.name: SetLeftMargin
functions.documentation: Sets the margin from the left border of the page.

params.name: left
params.description: The margin from the left border of the page. The unit is point (pt).

functions.name: SetLevelPictures
functions.documentation: Sets the picture indexes for all items at a particular level.
functions.syntax: treeviewname.SetLevelPictures ( level, pictureindex, selectedpictureindex, statepictureindex, overlaypictureindex)

params.name: treeviewname
params.description: The TreeView control in which you want to set the pictures for a given TreeView level

params.name: level
params.description: The TreeView level for which you are setting the picture indexes

params.name: pictureindex
params.description: An index from the regular picture list specifying the picture to be displayed when the item is not selected

params.name: selectedpictureindex
params.description: An index from the regular picture list specifying the picture to be displayed when the item is selected

params.name: statepictureindex
params.description: An index from the state picture list specifying the picture to be displayed to the left of the regular picture

params.name: overlaypictureindex
params.description: An index from the overlay picture list specifying the picture to be displayed on top of the regular picture

functions.name: SetLibraryList
functions.documentation: Changes the files in the library search path of the application at runtime.

params.name: filelist
params.description: A comma-separated list of file names. Specify the full file name with its extension. If you do not specify a path, PowerBuilder uses the system's search path to find the file.

functions.name: SetLinkAddress
functions.documentation: Links the current object to a URL.

params.name: linkAddress
params.description: The URL that the current object links to. It may be a URL to a local file, FTP address, HTTP/HTTPS address, or an email address. The supported URL protocols include: For accessing a local file: file:// For accessing an FTP address: ftp:// For accessing an HTTP address: http:// For accessing an HTTPS address: https:// For accessing an email address: mailto://

functions.name: SetMask
functions.documentation: Sets the edit mask and edit mask datatype for an EditMask control.

params.name: editmaskname
params.description: The name of the EditMask for which you want to specify the edit mask.

params.name: maskdatatype
params.description: A MaskDataType enumerated datatype indicating the datatype of the mask. Values are: DateMask! DateTimeMask! DecimalMask! NumericMask! StringMask! TimeMask!

params.name: mask
params.description: A string whose value is the edit mask.

functions.name: SetMasterItem
functions.documentation: Sets a master menu item for the application menu in the RibbonBar control.
functions.syntax: controlname.SetMasterItem ( { Long ParentIndex, } Long Index, RibbonMenuItem Item )

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonApplicationMenu control in which you want to set the master menu item.

params.name: ParentIndex
params.description: The index of the master menu item (RibbonMenuItem) whose submenu item you want to set. If not specified, the master menu item will be set; if specified to a valid value, the submenu item of the master menu item (whose index is ParentIndex) will be set; if specified to an invalid value, an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

params.name: Index
params.description: The index for the master menu item or submenu item for which you want to set. If index is invalid, an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

params.name: Item
params.description: A RibbonMenuItem item you want to set. Only RibbonMenuItem with "Normal(0)" or "Separator(1)" ItemType is supported. If RibbonMenuItem is with other ItemType such as "Recent(2)", an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

functions.name: SetMenu
functions.documentation: Sets a menu to the button in the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonApplicationButtonItem, RibbonTabButtonItem, RibbonLargeButtonItem, or RibbonSmallButtonItem control.

params.name: ApplicationMenu
params.description: The RibbonApplicationMenu item you want to set.

params.name: Menu
params.description: The RibbonMenu item you want to set.

functions.name: SetMessage
functions.documentation: Sets an error message for an object of type Throwable.

params.name: throwableobject
params.description: Object of type Throwable for which you want to set an error message.

params.name: newMessage
params.description: String containing the message you want to set. Must be surrounded by quotation marks.

functions.name: SetMicroHelp
functions.documentation: Specifies the text to be displayed in the MicroHelp box in an MDI frame window.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of the MDI frame window with MicroHelp for which you want to set the MicroHelp text

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose value is the new MicroHelp text

functions.name: SetMinimized
functions.documentation: Sets the RibbonBar control to be minimized.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: Minimized
params.description: A boolean indicating whether to set the RibbonBar control to be minimized.

functions.name: SetNewMobiLinkPassword
functions.documentation: Sets a new password for the current MobiLink user.

params.name: syncObject
params.description: The name of the synchronization object that starts a connection to the synchronization server.

params.name: newPW
params.description: A string consisting of the new password that you want to set for MobiLink.

functions.name: SetNull
functions.documentation: Sets a variable to null. The variable can be any datatype except for a structure or autoinstantiated object.

params.name: anyvariable
params.description: The variable you want to set to null

functions.name: SetOAuthToken
functions.documentation: Sets the OAuth 2.0 token string to the HTTP request header which will be sent to the server in the following interface: Submit , SendGetRequest , SendPostRequest , SendDeleteRequest , SendPatchRequest , SendPutRequest , Retrieve , and RetrieveOne . If a token has been set in the HTTP request header, it will replace the original token.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the RESTClient object in which you want to set the OAuth 2.0 access token.

params.name: token
params.description: A string value specifying the OAuth 2.0 access token.

functions.name: SetOverlayPicture
functions.documentation: Puts an image in the control's image list into an overlay image list.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the ListView or TreeView control to which you want to add an overlay image.

params.name: overlayindex
params.description: The index number of the overlay picture in the overlay image list. The overlay image list is a 1-based array. Overlayindex must be 1 (for the first image), a previously designated index (replacing an image), or 1 greater than the current largest index (adding another image). SetOverlayPicture fails if you specify an index that creates gaps in the array.

params.name: imageindex
params.description: The index number of an image in the control's main image list. For ListViews, both the large and small pictures at that index become overlay images. The image is still available for use as an item's main image.

functions.name: SetPageSize
functions.documentation: Sets the page size of the PDFPage object.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the page of the PDFPage object. The unit is point (pt).

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the page of the PDFPage object. The unit is point (pt).

params.name: PageSize
params.description: A value of the PDFPageSize enumerated datatype specifying the standard page sizes. Values are: PDFPage_A1! -- Width 59.4cm (1684 points), Height 84.0cm (2380 points) PDFPage_A2! -- Width 52.0m (1190 points), Height 59.4cm (1684 points) PDFPage_A3! -- Width 29.7cm (842 points), Height 42.0cm (1190 points) PDFPage_A4! -- Width 21.0cm (595 points), Height 29.7cm (842 points) PDFPage_Letter! -- Width 21.59cm (612 points), Height 27.94cm (792 points) PDFPage_Legal! -- Width 21.59cm (612 points), Height 35.56cm (1008 points) The following page sizes are not included in PDFPageSize. You need to manually specify the page width and height: Width 2380 points, and height 3368 points, for the A0 page size Width 421 points, and height 595 points, for the A5 page size Width 297 points, and height 421 points, for the A6 page size Width 501 points, and height 709 points, for the B5 page size Width 1224 points, and height 792 points, for the ledger page size Width 792 points, and height 1224 points, for the 11*17 page size

functions.name: SetPanel
functions.documentation: Sets the panel for the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle of the panel on the same level that you will set the panel.

params.name: Item
params.description: A panel item you are setting.

functions.name: SetParagraphSetting
functions.documentation: Sets the size of the indentation, left margin, or right margin of the paragraph containing the insertion point in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtecontrol
params.description: The name of the control for which you want paragraph information.

params.name: whichsetting
params.description: A value of the ParagraphSetting enumerated datatype specifying the setting you want to change. Values are: Indent! -- Returns the indentation of the paragraph LeftMargin! -- Returns the left margin of the paragraph RightMargin! -- Returns the right margin of the paragraph

params.name: value
params.description: A long whose value is the width of the margin or indent in units of 1000ths of an inch. For example, a value of 500 specifies a width of half an inch.

functions.name: SetParm
functions.documentation: Sets the parameters to send to the MobiLink synchronization server.

params.name: syncObject
params.description: The name of the synchronization object.

params.name: syncparm
params.description: A structure of type SyncParm containing property values that can be set as synchronization parameters.

functions.name: SetPicture
functions.documentation: Assigns an image stored in a blob to be the image in a Picture control.

params.name: picturecontrol
params.description: The name of a Picture control in which you want to set the bitmap.

params.name: bimage
params.description: A blob containing the new bitmap. bimage must be a valid picture in bitmap (BMP), Compuserve Graphics Interchange Format (GIF), Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG), run-length encoded (RLE), or Windows Metafile (WMF).

functions.name: SetPointer
functions.documentation: Sets the mouse pointer to a specified shape.

params.name: type
params.description: A value of the Pointer enumerated datatype indicating the type of pointer you want. Values are: AppStarting! Arrow! Cross! Beam! Help! HourGlass! Hyperlink! Icon! None! Size! SizeNS! SizeNESW! SizeWE! SizeNWSE! UpArrow!

params.name: shape
params.description: A string reference to a CUR file specifying the pointer type that you want to use.

functions.name: SetPosByPageIndex
functions.documentation: Sets the page index of the table of contents in the PDF document.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: The page index of the table of contents in the PDF document.The value is 1 by default.

functions.name: SetPosition
functions.documentation: Specifies the front-to-back position of a control in a window, a window, or an object within a DataWindow, or a PDF Builder object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of a control for which you want to specify a location in the front-to-back order within the window, or the name of a window for which you want to specify whether it always displays on top. Objectname cannot be a child window or a sheet.

params.name: position
params.description: A SetPosType enumerated datatype. The values you can specify depend on whether objectname is a control or a window. For controls, values are: Behind! -- Position objectname behind precedingobject in the order ToTop! -- Position objectname on top of all other controls ToBottom! -- Position objectname behind all other controls For windows, values are: TopMost! -- Always display objectname on top of all other open windows NoTopMost! -- Do not always display objectname on top of all other open windows

params.name: precedingobject
params.description: The name of the object you want to position objectname behind. Precedingobject is required if position is Behind!.

params.name: dwcontrol
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control or DataStore containing the object.

params.name: band
params.description: The name of the band or layer in which you want to position objectname. Layer names are background and foreground. Band names are detail, header, footer, summary, header.#, and trailer.#. # is the group level number. Enter the empty string ("") if you do not want to change the band

params.name: bringtofront
params.description: A boolean indicating whether you want to bring objectname to the front within the band: TRUE -- Bring it to the front FALSE -- Do not bring it to the front

params.name: x
params.description: The X coordinate. The unit is point (pt).

params.name: y
params.description: The Y coordinate. The unit is point (pt).

functions.name: SetPowerServerURL
functions.documentation: Sets the PowerServer root URL (the Web API URL) for the installable cloud application. This function is only effective in the installable cloud app deployed with PowerServer.

params.name: applicationname
params.description: The name of the application object for which you want to set the Web API URL.

params.name: asurl
params.description: The new Web API URL you want to set, in the format: scheme://host[:port][/path], scheme can be lowercase "http" or "https", for example, https://www.example.com/salesapi.

functions.name: SetProfileString
functions.documentation: Writes a value in a profile file for a PowerBuilder application.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the profile file. If you do not include the full path in filename, PowerBuilder searches the DOS path for filename.

params.name: section
params.description: A string whose value is the name of a group of related values in the profile file. If section does not exist in the file, PowerBuilder adds it.

params.name: key
params.description: A string whose value is the key in section for which you want to specify a value. If key does not exist in section, PowerBuilder adds it.

params.name: value
params.description: A string whose value is the value you want to specify for key.

functions.name: SetProxy
functions.documentation: Sets the server proxy of this email message.
functions.syntax: smtpclient.SetProxy(string host, long port{, integer proxytype}{, string username , string password})

params.name: smtpclient
params.description: A SMTP client object identifying the client in which you want to set the server proxy.

params.name: host
params.description: A string that contains the proxy services. When it is set to an empty value, it indicates the server proxy is cancelled.

params.name: port
params.description: A long that contains the services port.

params.name: proxytype
params.description: Specifies the values of the proxy type. Values are: 0 -- Use SOCKS4 Proxy. 1 -- Use SOCKS4a Proxy. The proxy resolves URL hostname. 2 -- Use SOCKS5 Proxy. 3 -- (Default) Use SOCKS5h Proxy. The proxy resolves URL hostname.

params.name: username
params.description: A string that contains the services proxy name.

params.name: password
params.description: A string that contains the services proxy password.

functions.name: SetQuickAccessToolbarStatusPath
functions.documentation: Sets the file path of the QuickAccessToolbar item status (QatItems.qat).

params.name: applicationname
params.description: The name of the application object for which you want to set the file path of the QuickAccessToolbar item status.

params.name: path
params.description: A string that specifies the path to the QuickAccessToolbar status. It should be a valid path.

functions.name: SetRange
functions.documentation: Sets a duration for a progress bar control or sets the start and end position for a trackbar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the progress bar or trackbar

params.name: startpos
params.description: Integer indicating the initial position of the range

params.name: endpos
params.description: Integer indicating the terminal position of the range

functions.name: SetReadOnly
functions.documentation: Sets as object as readonly.

params.name: bReadOnly
params.description: The readonly state, True or False.

functions.name: SetRecentItem
functions.documentation: Sets a recent menu item for the application menu in the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonApplicationMenu control in which you want to set the recent menu item.

params.name: Index
params.description: The index of the recent menu item for which you want to set. If index is invalid, an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

params.name: Item
params.description: A RibbonMenuItem item you want to set. Only RibbonMenuItem with "Recent(2)" ItemType is supported. If RibbonMenuItem is with other ItemType such as "Normal(0)" or "Separator(1)", an error would occur and this operation would return -1.

functions.name: SetRecentTitle
functions.documentation: Sets the title for the recent menu list in the application menu. The title will be displayed on top of the recent menu list.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonApplicationMenu control in which you want to set the title of the recent menu list.

params.name: Title
params.description: Title of the recent menu list. It will be displayed on top of the recent menu list.

functions.name: SetRecordSet
functions.documentation: Sets an ADOResultSet object to obtain its data and metadata from a passed ADO Recordset.

params.name: adoresultset
params.description: An ADOResultSet object into which the function places the passed ADO Recordset.

params.name: adorecordsetobject
params.description: An OLEObject object that contains an ADO Recordset. Passing an OLEObject that does not contain an ADO Recordset generates an error.

functions.name: SetRedraw
functions.documentation: Controls the automatic redrawing of an object or control after each change to its properties.

functions.name: SetRemote
functions.documentation: Asks a DDE server application to accept data and store it in the specified location. There are two ways of calling SetRemote, depending on the type of DDE connection you have established.
functions.syntax: SetRemote ( location, value, applname, topicname {, bAnsi} )

params.name: location
params.description: A string whose value is the location of the data in the server application that will accept the data. The format of location depends on the application that will receive the request.

params.name: value
params.description: A string whose value you want to send to the remote application.

params.name: applname
params.description: A string whose value is the DDE name of the server application.

params.name: topicname
params.description: A string identifying the data or the instance of the application that will accept the data (for example, in Microsoft Excel, the topic name could be the name of an open spreadsheet).

params.name: bAnsi
params.description: A boolean identifying whether the string to send to the DDE server is in ANSI format. If bAnsi is NULL, false, or empty, PowerBuilder will first try to send the data in a UNICODE formatted string. If bAnsi is true, PowerBuilder will try to send the data in an ANSI formatted string.

params.name: handle
params.description: A long that identifies the channel to the DDE server application. Handle is the value returned by OpenChannel, which you call to open a DDE channel.

params.name: windowhandle
params.description: The handle to the window that is acting as the DDE client.

functions.name: SetRequestHeader
functions.documentation: Sets the request header.
functions.syntax: objectname.SetRequestHeader ( string headerName, string headerValue{, Boolean replace } )

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the HTTPClient or RestClient object in which you want to set the request header.

params.name: headerName
params.description: A string whose value is the header name.

params.name: headerValue
params.description: A string whose value is the header value.

params.name: replace
params.description: A boolean determines whether to replace the current existing request value if the same header name already exists. TRUE -- to replace the value in the current existing request header if the same header name already exists. FALSE -- to add the value (with a “,”) to the current existing request header if the same header name already exists. The default value is FALSE. params.name: seriesname

params.name: colortype

params.name: color
params.description: A long specifying the new color for colortype.

params.name: linestyle
params.description: A value of the LineStyle enumerated datatype. Values are: Continuous! Dash! DashDot! DashDotDot! Dot! Transparent!

params.name: linewidth
params.description: An integer specifying the width of the line in pixels.

params.name: enumvalue
params.description: A value of an enumerated datatype specifying an appearance setting for the series. Values for the FillPattern or grSymbolType enumerated datatypes follow.

params.name: overlaystyle

functions.name: SetSeriesTransparency

functions.name: SetSheetID

params.name: height

params.name: ItemHandle

functions.name: SetSpacing

functions.name: SetState

Values are: PDFTableOfContentsStyle_Classic! -- The classic style. For example, title.........1. PDFTableOfContentsStyle_Simple! -- The simple style. For example, title 1.

functions.name: SetSyncRegistryProperties

params.name: syncObject
params.description: The name of the synchronization object.

functions.name: SetTab
functions.documentation: Modifies the alignment and position of a tab stop in a RichTextEdit control. If the specified tab stop does not exist, a new tab stop will be inserted.
functions.syntax: rtename.SetTab (integer tabcurrent, integer tabtype, integer tabpos)

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to set the tab stop

params.name: tabcurrent
params.description: An integer indicating the order/sequence of the tab stop that you want to set. If the tab stop specified by tabcurrent does not exist (for example, when there are only two tab stops, while tabcurrent is set to 3), a new tab stop will be inserted. No more than 14 tab stops can be added and set, which means, valid value for tabcurrent is between 1 and 14. If invalid value is used, -1 will return. The tabcurrent value for a tab stop will change if the order of the tab stop is changed (because the position can be modified by tabpos, and the position determines the order).

params.name: tabtype
params.description: An integer specifying the alignment of the tab stop. Possible values are: 1: Left-aligned tab stop -- The text will be aligned to the left when it reaches this tab stop. 2: Right-aligned tab stop -- The text will be aligned to the right at this tab stop. 3: Center-aligned tab stop -- The text will be centred at this tab stop. 4: Decimal-aligned tab stop -- Useful for aligning numbers with decimal points (e.g. for financial documents). 5: Rightmost tab stop -- The text will be placed at the furthest right edge, often used for right-aligned columns or data. tabpos will be ignored for this type.

params.name: tabpos
params.description: An integer specifying the position of the tab stop. This is the distance from the left margin where the tab stop will be placed. It is measured in twip (Twentieth of a Point). When the position of a tab stop is changed, the order of existing tab stops may change as well, which means, the tabcurrent value of each tab stop may change too.

functions.name: SetTabButton
functions.documentation: Sets the tab button for the RibbonBar control.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonBar control.

params.name: ItemHandle
params.description: The handle of the tab button on the same level that you will set the tab button.

params.name: Item
params.description: A tab button item you are setting.

params.name: toc

params.name: colornumber

params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to set the font name

functions.name: SetTextStyle
functions.documentation: Specifies the text formatting for selected text in a RichTextEdit control. You can make the text bold, underlined, italic, and struck out. You can also make it either a subscript or superscript.
functions.syntax: rtename.SetTextStyle ( bold, underline {, subscript} {, superscript}, italic, strikeout )

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to specify formatting for selected text.

params.name: bold
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is bold.

params.name: underline
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is underlined.

params.name: subscript
params.description: Maintained for backward compatibility only. A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is a subscript. This value is currently ignored.

params.name: superscript
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is a superscript. Maintained for backward compatibility only. If both subscript and superscript are true, subscript takes precedence and the text is subscripted. This value is currently ignored.

params.name: italic
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is italic.

params.name: strikeout
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the selected text is has a line drawn through it.

functions.name: SetTitle
functions.documentation: Sets the title in the table of contents.

params.name: title
params.description: Optional. The title in the table of contents.

params.description: The name of the control for which you want to set the Today date

functions.name: SetToolbar
functions.documentation: Specifies the alignment, visibility, and title for the specified toolbar.

params.name: window
params.description: The MDI frame or sheet to which the toolbar belongs.

params.name: toolbarindex
params.description: An integer whose value is the index of the toolbar whose settings you want to change.

params.name: visible
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether to make the toolbar visible. Values are: TRUE -- Make the toolbar visible FALSE -- Hide the toolbar

params.name: alignment
params.description: A value of the ToolbarAlignment enumerated datatype specifying the alignment for the toolbar. Values are: AlignAtTop! -- Dock the toolbar at the top of the frame. AlignAtLeft! -- Dock the toolbar on the left side of the frame. AlignAtRight! -- Dock the toolbar on the right side of the frame. AlignAtBottom! -- Dock the toolbar at the bottom of the frame. Floating! -- Float the toolbar. The floating toolbar has its own frame and miniature title bar

params.name: floatingtitle
params.description: A string whose value is the title for the toolbar when its alignment is Floating!.

functions.name: SetToolbarPos
functions.documentation: Sets the position of the specified toolbar.

params.name: window
params.description: The MDI frame or sheet to which the toolbar belongs.

params.name: toolbarindex
params.description: An integer whose value is the index of the toolbar whose settings you want to change.

params.name: dockrow
params.description: An integer whose value is the number of the docking row for the toolbar. Docking rows are numbered from left to right or top to bottom.

params.name: offset
params.description: An integer whose value specifies the distance of the toolbar from the beginning of the docking row. For toolbars at the top or bottom, offset is measured from the left edge. For toolbars on the left or right, offset is measured from the top. If insert is true, the offset you specify is adjusted so that the toolbar does not overlap others in the row. Specify an offset of 0 to position the toolbar ahead of other toolbars in dockrow.

params.name: insert
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether you want to insert the specified toolbar before the toolbars in dockrow causing them to move over or down a row, or you want to add toolbarindex to dockrow. Values are: TRUE -- Move any toolbars already in dockrow or higher rows over or down a row so that the toolbar you are moving is the only toolbar in the row. FALSE -- Add the toolbar you are moving to dockrow. Its position in relation to other toolbars in the row is determined by offset.

params.name: x
params.description: An integer whose value is the x coordinate of the floating toolbar

params.name: y
params.description: An integer whose value is the y coordinate of the floating toolbar

params.name: width
params.description: An integer whose value is the width of the floating toolbar

params.name: height
params.description: An integer whose value is the height of the floating toolbar

params.description: A boolean specifying the flag: true indicates the value is in JSON format, false indicates the value is a string. The default value is true.

params.name: DWControl

params.name: ChangedOnly
params.description: A boolean specifying the changing flag: true indicates including changed data only (in DataWindow JSON format) for all DataWindow buffers, false indicates including data (in plain JSON format) of primary buffer. The default value is true.

functions.documentation: Sets the blob value for a key. If the key does not exist, then create the key and set its value. If the key already exists, then overwrite the value of this key. If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: Value
params.description: A blob specifying the key value.

functions.name: SetValueBoolean
functions.documentation: Sets the boolean value for a key. If the key does not exist, then create the key and set its value. If the key already exists, then overwrite the value of this key. If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: Value
params.description: A boolean specifying the key value.

functions.name: SetValueByDataWindow
functions.documentation: Sets the value of the key using the data from a DataWindow control, DataStore object, or DataWindowChild object.
functions.syntax: objectname.SetValueByDataWindow ( string Key, dwcontrol DWControl {, boolean format } )

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: dwcontrol
params.description: A reference to a DataWindow control, DataStore, or DataWindowChild.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to get the data. For a list of valid values, see the section called “DWBuffer” in DataWindow Reference . If not specified, all of the DataWindow buffers will be obtained, however, the data for DataWindowChild will not be obtained (even if changedonly is false).

params.name: changedonly
params.description: A boolean specifying the changing flag. True -- to get the changed rows only (and all rows of the Delete buffer). False -- to get all rows. The default is false.

params.name: primarydata
params.description: A boolean specifying whether to get the data from the primary buffer. True -- to get False -- not to get

params.name: filterdata
params.description: A boolean specifying whether to get the data from the filter buffer. True -- to get False -- not to get

params.name: deletedata
params.description: A boolean specifying whether to get the data from the delete buffer. True -- to get False -- not to get

params.name: dwcdata
params.description: A boolean specifying whether to get the DataWindowChild data. True -- to get. If it is to get the DataWindowChild data, data from all buffers will be set to a plain JSON, regardless of the value of the other arguments. False -- not to get

params.name: startrow
params.description: The number of the first detail row in the buffer that you want to get. The default is 1. If it is 0 or negative, 1 is used.

params.name: endrow
params.description: The number of the last detail row in the buffer that you want to get. The default is the rest of the rows. If it is 0 or negative, it indicates the rest of rows.

params.name: startcolumn
params.description: The number of the first column in the buffer that you want to get. The default is 1. If it is 0 or negative, 1 is used.

params.name: endcolumn
params.description: The number of the last column in the buffer that you want to get. The default is the rest of the columns. If it is 0 or negative, it indicates the rest of columns.

params.name: format
params.description: A boolean specifying the JSON format. True indicates the DataWindow JSON. False (default) indicates the plain JSON. See the section called “Supported JSON formats” in Application Techniques for details about the JSON format.

functions.name: SetValueDate
functions.documentation: Sets the date value for a key. If the key does not exist, then create the key and set its value. If the key already exists, then overwrite the value of this key. If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: Value
params.description: A date specifying the key value.

functions.name: SetValueDateTime
functions.documentation: Sets the datetime value for a key. If the key does not exist, then create the key and set its value. If the key already exists, then overwrite the value of this key. If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key

A JsonStringItem type value is a string converted from the local time directly (no timezone conversion).

Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname

If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: Value
params.description: A string specifying the key value.

functions.name: SetValueTime
functions.documentation: Sets the time value for a key. If the key does not exist, then create the key and set its value. If the key already exists, then overwrite the value of this key. If more than one key with the same name already exists, then overwrite the value of the first key. Notice that the IgnoreCase property (true by default) determines whether the key name will be matched in a case-sensitive manner.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the JSONPackage object.

params.name: Key
params.description: A string specifying the key name.

params.name: Value
params.description: A time specifying the key value.

functions.name: SHA

params.name: algorithm

(for English characters only) or EncodingUTF8!, otherwise, the default EncodingUTF16LE! will be used.

functions.name: StartHotLink
functions.documentation: Establishes a hot link with a DDE server application so that PowerBuilder is notified immediately of any changes in the specified data. When the data changes in the server application, it triggers a HotLinkAlarm event in the current application.

params.description: A string whose value is the location of the data in which a change of value triggers a HotLinkAlarm event. The format of the location depends on the application that contains the data.

params.name: applname
params.description: A string whose value is the DDE name of the server application.

params.name: topic
params.description: A string identifying the data or the instance of the application in which a change triggers a HotLinkAlarm event (for example, in Microsoft Excel, the topic name could be the name of an open spreadsheet).

params.name: bAnsi
params.description: A boolean identifying whether the string to get from the DDE server is in ANSI format. If bAnsi is NULL, false, or empty, PowerBuilder will first try to get the data in a UNICODE formatted string. If bAnsi is true, PowerBuilder will try to get the data in an ANSI formatted string.

functions.name: StartMerge
functions.documentation: Indicates the merge mode starts. The database operations after the StartMerge label will not be executed until the EndMerge label is called. Using the merge mode, multiple database requests are consolidated into one request, so as to reduce the number of server calls. Make sure to read the Usage section below in order to use these label functions properly. This function takes effect only when the application is deployed via the PowerServer project (it will be ignored when the application is deployed via the PowerClient project or the Application project).

params.name: objectname

If data is type string, format is required. The format can consist of more than one mask, depending on the datatype of data. Each mask is separated by a semicolon. (For details on each datatype, see Usage).

functions.name: Submit
functions.documentation: Sends the data to the server via the HTTP POST method and then gets the response body from the server. It is NOT supported to use this method to process large data (20 MB or 100,000 data rows can be considered as large data based on our tests).
functions.syntax: objectname.Submit(string urlName, ref string response, DWControl dwObject{, boolean format})

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the RESTClient object.

params.name: urlName
params.description: The URL indicating where the data will be submitted.

params.name: response
params.description: The content of the server response. If RESTClient failed to send request or server provides no response, the response value is an empty string. If the response value is compressed, it will be automatically decompressed. Gzip and Brotli compression formats are supported. If the server specified the Content-Type response header, and in which the encoding charset is specified, this function will encode the data with the specified charset, if charset is not specified, this function will encode the data in UTF-8 by default.

params.name: dwObject
params.description: The DataWindow control, DataStore, or DataWindowChild object whose data will be submitted.

params.name: primarydata
params.description: A boolean indicating whether to export and submit the data from the primary buffer. True -- to export. False -- not to export.

params.name: filterdata
params.description: A boolean indicating whether to export and submit the data from the filter buffer. True -- to export. False -- not to export.

params.name: deletedata
params.description: A boolean indicating whether to export and submit the data from the delete buffer. True -- to export. False -- not to export.

params.name: dwcdata
params.description: A boolean specifying whether to export the DataWindowChild data. True -- to export. If it is to export the DataWindowChild data, data from all buffers will be exported to a plain JSON, regardless of the value of the other arguments. False -- not to export.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to export the data. For a list of valid values, see the section called “DWBuffer” in DataWindow Reference . If not specified, all of the DataWindow buffers will be exported, however, the data for DataWindowChild will not be exported (even if changedonly is false).

params.name: startrow
params.description: A long value specifying the start row in the dwbuffer DataWindow buffer. The default is 1. If it is 0 or negative, 1 is used.

params.name: endrow
params.description: A long value specifying the end row in the dwbuffer DataWindow buffer. The default is the rest of the rows. If it is 0 or negative, it indicates the rest of rows.

params.name: startcol
params.description: A long value specifying the start column in the dwbuffer DataWindow buffer. The default is 1. If it is 0 or negative, 1 is used.

params.name: endcol
params.description: A long value specifying the end column in the dwbuffer DataWindow buffer. The default is the rest of the columns. If it is 0 or negative, it indicates the rest of columns.

params.name: changedonly
params.description: A boolean specifying the changing flag. True -- to export the changed rows only (and all rows of the Delete buffer). False -- to export all rows. The default is false.

params.name: format
params.description: A boolean specifying the JSON format. True indicates the DataWindow JSON. For syntax 1, 3, 4, the default is true. False indicates the plain JSON. For syntax 2, the default is false. See the section called “Supported JSON formats” in Application Techniques for details about the JSON format.

params.name: package
params.description: A reference to JsonPackage object whose data will be submitted.

functions.name: SymmetricDecrypt
functions.documentation: Decrypts a blob value using symmetric algorithm.
functions.syntax: crypter.SymmetricDecrypt ( algorithm, variable, key{, operationmode{, iv{, padding}}})

params.name: crypter
params.description: The name of the CrypterObject object.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: A value of the SymmetricAlgorithm enumerated type that specifies the type of symmetric algorithm. Values are: AES! – The Advanced Encryption Standard DES! – The Data Encryption Standard TDES! – The Triple-DES DESX! – The DES-XEX3 Blowfish! – The Blowfish

params.name: variable
params.description: A blob whose value is the data you want to decrypt with symmetric algorithm. When using the system blob function to convert a string to a blob, it is recommended to specify its encoding argument to be EncodingANSI! (for English characters only) or EncodingUTF8!, otherwise, the default EncodingUTF16LE! will be used.

params.name: key
params.description: A blob specifying the secret key. The length of the secret key can be 128 bits, 192 bits, 256 bits with AES. The length of the secret key must be 64 bits with DES. The length of the secret key can be 128 bits, 192 bits with TDES. The length of the secret key must be 192 bits with DESX. The length of the secret key can be 32 bits~448 bits with Blowfish.

params.name: operationmode
params.description: A value of the OperationMode enumerated type that specifies the mode of operation. Values are: OperationModeECB! – (Default) The Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode OperationModeCBC! – The Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode OperationModeCFB! – The Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode OperationModeOFB! – The Output Feedback (OFB) mode OperationModeCTR! – The Counter (CTR) mode

params.name: iv
params.description: A blob specifying the initialization vector. Zeros filled by default. In the AES algorithm, the effective length of the iv is 16 bytes and the others are 8 bytes. If the length is not enough, it will be automatically filled with zeros. In the ECB operation mode, the iv will be ignored.

params.name: padding
params.description: A value of the PaddingScheme enumerated type that specifies the padding schemes used for block cipher. Values are: NoPadding! – No padding added to a block ZerosPadding! – 0's padding added to a block PKCSPadding! – PKCS #5 padding added to a block OneAndZerosPadding! – 1 and 0's padding added to a block DefaultPadding! – (Default) Default padding scheme. DefaultPadding! means PKCSPadding! for ECB or CBC mode. Otherwise, NoPadding! for modes like CFB, OFB, and CTR. ZerosPadding!, PKCSPadding!, and OneAndZerosPadding! can be used with ECB and CBC operation mode. NoPadding! can be used with CFB, OFB and CTR operation mode.

params.name: algorithm

params.name: variable
params.description: A blob whose value is the data you want to encrypt with symmetric algorithm. When using the system blob function to convert a string to a blob, it is recommended to specify its encoding argument to be EncodingANSI! (for English characters only) or EncodingUTF8!, otherwise, the default EncodingUTF16LE! will be used.

params.name: key
params.description: A blob specifying the secret key. The length of the secret key can be 128 bits, 192 bits, 256 bits with AES. The length of the secret key must be 64 bits with DES. The length of the secret key can be 128 bits, 192 bits with TDES. The length of the secret key must be 192 bits with DESX. The length of the secret key can be 32 bits~448 bits with Blowfish.

params.name: operationmode
params.description: A value of the OperationMode enumerated type that specifies the mode of operation. Values are: OperationModeECB! – (Default) The Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode OperationModeCBC! – The Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode OperationModeCFB! – The Cipher Feedback (CFB) mode OperationModeOFB! – The Output Feedback (OFB) mode OperationModeCTR! – The Counter (CTR) mode

params.name: iv
params.description: A blob specifying the initialization vector. Zeros filled by default. In the AES algorithm, the effective length of the iv is 16 bytes and the others are 8 bytes. If the length is not enough, it will be automatically filled with zeros. In the ECB operation mode, the iv will be ignored.

params.name: padding
params.description: A value of the PaddingScheme enumerated type that specifies the padding schemes used for block cipher. Values are: NoPadding! – No padding added to a block ZerosPadding! – 0's padding added to a block PKCSPadding! – PKCS #5 padding added to a block OneAndZerosPadding! – 1 and 0's padding added to a block DefaultPadding! – (Default) Default padding scheme. DefaultPadding! means PKCSPadding! for ECB or CBC mode. Otherwise, NoPadding! for modes like CFB, OFB, and CTR. params.name: len

functions.name: TableGetCellTextGap

params.name: tableID

functions.name: TableGetCellTextType
functions.documentation: Gets the type of content in a table cell in the RichTextEdit control. The text type of the table cell may be txStandard (for text content) or txNumber (for number content), set in TableSetCellTextType . If the type is txstandard, the content in the cell is interpreted as text and it is displayed as it is. If the type is txnumber, the content in the cell is interpreted as a number, with the period character (.) being defined as decimal separator, and the comma character (,) is defined as thousands separator.
functions.syntax: integer rtename.TableGetCellTextType(long tableID, long row, long column)

params.name: tableID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the table.

params.name: row
params.description: The row number of the cell.

params.name: column
params.description: The column number of the cell.

params.name: row

params.name: column

params.name: align
params.description: The align mode of the content in the cell. The following modes are supported: 1 -- The text is aligned at the top of the cell. 2 -- The text is vertically centered. 3 -- The text is aligned at the bottom of the cell.

functions.name: TableInsert
functions.documentation: Inserts a table in the RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rows
params.description: The number of rows to add in the new table.

params.name: column
params.description: The number of columns to add in the new table.

params.name: textPos
params.description: The position to insert the new table, which will be the character index (starting at 1) of the first character of the table cell in the RichTextEdit control. If there are new line characters in the content, each new line character is counted as one character too. If the RichTextEdit control contains header and footer, the character indexes of the header, footer and main content are accumulated separately. By default, textPos is -1, meaning to insert the new table at the current text input position.

functions.name: TableInsertColumn
functions.documentation: Inserts a column to the right or left of the current text input position in the table.

params.name: position
params.description: The position to insert the new column. The following values are supported: 0 -- Insert the column to the left of the column with the current text input position. 1 -- Insert the column to the right of the column with the current text input position.

functions.name: TableInsertDialog
functions.documentation: Displays a built-in Insert Table dialog (as shown below) for users to insert a table by themselves.

functions.name: TableInsertRow
functions.documentation: Inserts one above or below the current text input position in the table.

params.name: position
params.description: The position to insert the new row(s). The following values are supported: 1 -- Insert the row(s) above the row with the current text input position. 2 -- Insert the row(s) below the row with the current text input position.

functions.name: TableInsertRows
functions.documentation: Inserts one or more rows above or below the current text input position in the table.

params.name: position
params.description: The position to insert the new row(s). The following values are supported: 1 -- Insert the row(s) above the row with the current text input position. 2 -- Insert the row(s) below the row with the current text input position.

params.name: rows
params.description: The number of rows to insert.

functions.name: TableMergeCells

functions.name: TableNext
functions.documentation: Use this function to enumerate all tables in the RichTextEdit control. Enumeration numbers are used instead of table IDs for the enumeration, because it is possible that the table IDs in the current RichTextEdit control do not reflect the sequence of tables in it.
functions.syntax: integer rtename.TableNext(integer enumerationNumber, ref integer tableID)

params.name: enumerationNumber
params.description: Specifies an enumeration number. The method returns the enumeration number of the table that follows the table with this number. If this parameter is zero, the first table's enumeration number is returned.

params.name: tableID
params.description: The table ID of the next table.

params.name: activeTab

functions.name: TableRowAtInputPos

functions.name: TableSplitCells
functions.documentation: Splits all the selected cells in the table. However, only previously merged cells can be split.

functions.name: TabPostEvent
functions.documentation: Posts the specified event for each tab page in a Tab control, adding them to the end of the event queues for the tab page user objects.

params.name: tabcontrolname
params.description: The name of the Tab control for which you want to post events for its tab page user objects.

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for a tab page user object in tabcontrolname and a script must exist for the event in tabcontrolname.

params.name: word
params.description: A long value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs).

params.name: long
params.description: A long value or a string that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage for PostEvent ).

functions.name: TabTriggerEvent
functions.documentation: Triggers the specified event for each tab page in a Tab control, which executes the scripts immediately in the index order of the tab pages.

params.name: tabcontrolname
params.description: The name of the Tab control for which you want to trigger events for its tab page user objects.

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for a tab page user object in tabcontrolname and a script must exist for the event in tabcontrolname.

params.name: word
params.description: A long value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs).

params.name: long
params.description: A long value or a string that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage for TriggerEvent).

functions.name: Tan

params.name: n

params.name: id

functions.name: TargetGoto
functions.documentation: Moves the cursor to a specified target in a RichTextEdit control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to move the cursor to a specified target by the target ID

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the target that the cursor jumps to

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the target that the cursor jumps to. If there are multiple targets with the same name, the cursor will only jump to the first target. Name is case-sensitive.

functions.name: TargetInsert
functions.documentation: Inserts a target into the current position in a RichTextEdit control. The text in the inserted target will not be displayed in the control.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to insert a target into the current position

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the target to be inserted. You can insert multiple targets with the same name. Name is case sensitive.

params.name: deletable
params.description: A boolean specifying whether the inserted target can be deleted. Note: This argument specifies whether the end users can delete the target in RichTextEdit controls instead of using the TargetDelete function. The TargetDelete function can delete the target no matter what value the deletable argument is set to.

functions.name: TargetNext
functions.documentation: Gets the next target ID of the specified target.

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to get the next target ID of the specified target

params.name: id
params.description: The next target ID of the specified target. If you want to get the first target ID, this value should be set to 0.

params.name: id

params.name: name

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the item for which you want the text

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the RibbonComboBoxItem control for which you want to get the text

functions.name: TextFieldSetTypeAndData
functions.documentation: Sets the type and type data of the text field in a RichTextEdit control.
functions.syntax: rtename.TextFieldSetTypeAndData (integer id, string type, string typedata)

params.name: rtename
params.description: The name of the RichTextEdit control in which you want to set the type and type data of the text field

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the text field to be set

params.name: type
params.description: The type of the text field to be set. The following types are supported now (the strings are case-insensitive): standard -- The standard text type to which the newly inserted text field is set by default. If type is standard, the typedata argument will be ignored. externallink -- The external link that can link to the external document or URL. You can set the address of the external link by the typedata argument. internallink -- The internal link that can link to a location within the current document. You can set the address of the internal link which is also the target name by the typedata argument.

params.name: typedata
params.description: A string specifying the type data of the text field. If type is set to standard, the type data cannot be set in the text field and this argument will be ignored. If type is set to externallink, the type data represents the address of the external link. (for example, https://www.appeon.com) If type is set to internallink, the type data represents the name of an internal target.

functions.name: TextFrameInsert
functions.documentation: Inserts a new text frame anchored to a paragraph. The text flows around the text frame.
functions.syntax: integer rtename.TextFrameInsert(long textPos, integer alignment, long posX, long posY, integer width, integer height, integer textFlow, integer distanceL, integer distanceT, integer distanceR, integer distanceB)

params.name: textPos
params.description: Specifies a text position in the paragraph where to insert the text frame. If TextPos is -1, the text frame is anchored to the paragraph at the current input position.

params.name: alignment
params.description: Specifies the text frame's horizontal alignment. It can be one of the following values: 0 -- The horizontal position is given through the PosX parameter. 1 -- The text frame is left aligned relative to the paragraph to which it is anchored. 2 -- The text frame is right aligned relative to the paragraph to which it is anchored. 3 -- The text frame is centered relative to the paragraph to which it is anchored.

params.name: posX
params.description: The text frame's horizontal position in twips relative to the left border of the paragraph. This value is used if the Alignment parameter has been set to 0. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: posY
params.description: The text frame's vertical position in twips relative to the top border of the paragraph. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the text frame in twips. If this parameter is set to zero, a built-in mouse interface is started which enables the end-user to define the size of the text frame through a rectangle, drawn with the mouse. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the text frame in twips. If this parameter is set to zero, a built-in mouse interface is started which enables the end-user to define the size of the text frame through a rectangle, drawn with the mouse. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: textFlow
params.description: Specifies how text flows around the text frame. Values are: 2 -- The text stops at the top and continues at the bottom of the text frame. 3 -- The text flows around the text frame. Empty areas at the left and right side are filled.

params.name: distanceL
params.description: Specifies the left distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceT
params.description: Specifies the top distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceR
params.description: Specifies the right distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceB
params.description: Specifies the bottom distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: width
