params.name: height
params.description: The height of the text frame in twips. If this parameter is set to zero, a built-in mouse interface is started which enables the end-user to define the size of the text frame through a rectangle, drawn with the mouse. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

functions.name: TextFrameInsertFixed
functions.documentation: Inserts a new text frame at a fixed geometrical position. The text flows around the text frame.
functions.syntax: integer rtename.TextFrameInsertFixed(long pageNo, long posX, long PosY, integer width, integer height, integer textFlow, integer distanceL, integer distanceT, integer distanceR, integer distanceB)

params.name: pageNo
params.description: Specifies the number of the page where the text frame is inserted, beginning with number 1.

params.name: posX
params.description: The text frame's horizontal position in twips relative to the left border of the paragraph. This value is used if the Alignment parameter has been set to 0. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: posY
params.description: The text frame's vertical position in twips relative to the top border of the paragraph. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt). The value cannot be set to a value smaller than 0.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the text frame in twips. If this parameter is set to zero, a built-in mouse interface is started which enables the end-user to define the size of the text frame through a rectangle, drawn with the mouse. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the text frame in twips. If this parameter is set to zero, a built-in mouse interface is started which enables the end-user to define the size of the text frame through a rectangle, drawn with the mouse. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: textFlow
params.description: Specifies how text flows around the text frame. Values are: 2 -- The text stops at the top and continues at the bottom of the text frame. 3 -- The text flows around the text frame. Empty areas at the left and right side are filled.

params.name: distanceL
params.description: Specifies the left distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceT
params.description: Specifies the top distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceR
params.description: Specifies the right distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

params.name: distanceB
params.description: Specifies the bottom distances, in twips, between the text frame and the document's text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

functions.name: TextFrameSelect
functions.documentation: Selects a text frame for further programming. Note that this function does not set the input focus to a text frame and does not show the selection frame with the resize handles.

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame. It must be an identifier returned through the TextFrameInsert , TextFrameInsertAsChar or TextFrameInsertFixed method. If the argument is 0 (the default value), the text part with the current input position will be selected. If the argument is -1, the main text will be selected, independent of which text part has the current input focus.

functions.name: TextFrameSetBackColor
functions.documentation: Sets the background color of a text frame in the RichTextEdit control. The RichTextEdit control uses the Microsoft Windows operating environment red-green-blue (RGB) color scheme. The valid range for a RGB color is 0 to &HFFFFFF. The high byte of a number in this range equals 0; the lower 3 bytes, from least to most significant byte, determine the amount of red, green, and blue, respectively. The red, green, and blue components are each represented by a number between 0 and 255 (&HFF).

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame.

params.name: color
params.description: The background color of the text frame. The RichTextEdit control uses the Microsoft Windows operating environment red-green-blue (RGB) color scheme. The valid range for a RGB color is 0 to &HFFFFFF. The high byte of a number in this range equals 0; the lower 3 bytes, from least to most significant byte, determine the amount of red, green, and blue, respectively. The red, green, and blue components are each represented by a number between 0 and 255 (&HFF).

functions.name: TextFrameSetBorderWidth
functions.documentation: Sets the width of a text frame's border line in the RichTextEdit control.

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame.

params.name: Width
params.description: The width of the border line, in twips. For almost all units of measurement in the RichTextEdit control, twips are used. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt). If the value is 0, the text frame has no border line. For altering the distance between the border line and the text, use the TextFrameSetInternalMargin function.

functions.name: TextFrameSetInternalMargin
functions.documentation: Sets the distance (in twips) between a text frame's border line and the text. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).
functions.syntax: boolean rtename.TextFrameSetInternalMargin(integer textFrameID, integer index, integer margin)

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame.

params.name: index
params.description: Specifies one of the four possible margins: 1 -- Left; 2 -- Top; 3 -- Right; 4 -- Bottom.

params.name: margin
params.description: The actual margin between the boder line and text, in twips. For almost all units of measurement in the RichTextEdit control, twips are used. Twip is a fabricated word meaning twentieth of a point (pt).

functions.name: TextFrameSetMarkerLines
functions.documentation: Sets whether or not marker lines are visible for the text frame. Marker lines show a text frame's border if the text frame has no border line. A text frame's border line can be set with the TextFrameSetBorderWidth function.

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame.

params.name: markerLines
params.description: Specifies whether the marker lines are visible. True (Default) -- The marker lines are visible. False -- The marker lines are invisible.

functions.name: TextFrameSetText
functions.documentation: Sets the text for a text frame.

params.name: textFrameID
params.description: The unique ID that identifies the text frame.

params.name: start
params.description: The starting position in the text frame to add the text. 0 means the start of the text.

params.name: length
params.description: The length in the text frame to add the text. -1 means till the end of the text. 0 means the full length of the text being added.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to add in the text frame.

functions.name: TextLine
functions.documentation: Obtains the text of the line that contains the insertion point. TextLine works for controls that can contain multiple lines.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, EditMask, MultiLineEdit, or RichTextEdit control in which you want the text on the line that contains the insertion point

functions.name: Time
functions.documentation: Converts DateTime, string, or numeric data to data of type time. It also extracts a time value from a blob. You can use one of three syntaxes, depending on the datatype of the source data.

params.name: datetime
params.description: A DateTime value or a blob in which the first value is a time or DateTime value. The rest of the contents of the blob is ignored. Datetime can also be an Any variable containing a DateTime or blob.

params.name: string
params.description: A string whose value is a valid time (such as 8am or 10:25) that you want returned as a time. Only the hour is required; you do not have to include the minutes, seconds, or microseconds of the time or am or pm. The default value is 00 for minutes and seconds and 000000 for microseconds. PowerBuilder determines whether the time is am or pm based on a 24-hour clock. String can also be an Any variable containing a string or blob.

params.name: hour
params.description: The integer for the hour (00 to 23) of the time

params.name: minute
params.description: The integer for the minutes (00 to 59) of the time

params.name: second
params.description: The integer for the seconds (0 to 59) of the time

params.name: microsecond
params.description: The integer for the microseconds (0 to 32767) of the time (note that the range of values supported for this argument is less than the total range of values possible for a microsecond)

functions.name: Timer
functions.documentation: Causes a Timer event in a window to occur repeatedly at the specified interval. When you call Timer, it starts a timer. When the interval is over, PowerBuilder triggers the Timer event and resets the timer.

params.name: interval
params.description: The number of seconds that you want between Timer events. interval can be a whole number or fraction greater than 0 and less than or equal to 4,294,967 seconds. If interval is 0, Timer turns off the timer so that it no longer triggers Timer events.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The window in which you want the timer event to be triggered. The window must be an open window. If you do not specify a window, the Timer event occurs in the current window.

functions.name: ToAnsi
functions.documentation: Converts a character string to an ANSI blob. This function is obsolete starting from PowerBuilder 10.

params.name: string
params.description: A character string you want to convert to an ANSI blob

functions.name: Today
functions.documentation: Obtains the system date and, in some cases, the system time.

functions.name: Top
functions.documentation: Obtains the index number of the first visible item in a ListBox control. Top lets you to find out how the user has scrolled the list.

params.name: listboxname
params.description: The name of the ListBox or PictureListBox in which you want the index of the first visible item in the list

functions.name: TotalColumns
functions.documentation: Finds the number of columns in a ListView control.

params.name: listviewname
params.description: The name of the ListView control for which you want to find the number of columns

functions.name: TotalItems
functions.documentation: Determines the total number of items in a ListBox or RibbonComboBoxItem control.

params.name: listcontrolname
params.description: The name of the ListBox, DropDownListBox, PictureListBox, DropDownPictureListBox, ListView, or RibbonComboBoxItem in which you want the total number of items

functions.name: TotalSelected
functions.documentation: Determines the number of items in a ListBox control that are selected.

params.name: listcontrolname
params.description: The name of the ListBox, PictureListBox, or ListView in which you want the number of items that are selected

functions.name: ToUnicode
functions.documentation: Converts a character string to a Unicode blob. This function is obsolete starting from PowerBuilder 10.

params.name: string
params.description: A character string you want to convert to a Unicode blob

functions.name: TraceBegin
functions.documentation: Inserts an activity type value in the trace file indicating that logging has begun and then starts logging all the enabled application trace activities. Before calling TraceBegin, you must have opened the trace file using the TraceOpen function.

params.name: identifier
params.description: A read-only string, logged to the trace file, used to identify a tracing block. If identifier is null, an empty string is placed in the trace file.

functions.name: TraceClose
functions.documentation: Closes the trace file.

functions.name: TraceDisableActivity
functions.documentation: Disables logging of the specified trace activity.

params.name: activity
params.description: A value of the enumerated datatype TraceActivity that identifies the activity for which logging should be disabled. Values are: ActError! -- Occurrences of system errors and warnings ActESQL! -- Embedded SQL statement entry and exit ActGarbageCollect! -- Start and finish of garbage collection ActLine! -- Routine line hits ActObjectCreate! -- Object creation entry and exit ActObjectDestroy! -- Object destruction entry and exit ActProfile! -- Abbreviation for the ActRoutine!, ActESQL!, ActObjectCreate!, ActObjectDestroy!, and ActGarbageCollect! values ActRoutine! -- Routine entry and exit (if this value is disabled, ActLine! is automatically disabled) ActTrace! -- Abbreviation for all activities except ActLine! ActUser! -- Occurrences of an activity you selected

functions.name: TraceEnableActivity
functions.documentation: Enables logging of the specified trace activity.

params.name: activity
params.description: A value of the enumerated datatype TraceActivity that identifies the activity to be logged. Values are: ActError! -- Occurrences of system errors and warnings ActESQL! -- Embedded SQL statement entry and exit ActGarbageCollect! -- Start and finish of garbage collection ActLine! -- Routine line hits (if this value is enabled, ActRoutine! is automatically enabled) ActObjectCreate! -- Object creation entry and exit ActObjectDestroy! -- Object destruction entry and exit ActProfile! -- Abbreviation for the ActRoutine!, ActESQL!, ActObjectCreate!, ActObjectDestroy, and ActGarbageCollect! values ActRoutine! -- Routine entry and exit ActTrace! -- Abbreviation for all activities except ActLine!

functions.name: TraceEnd
functions.documentation: Inserts an activity type value in the trace file indicating that logging has ended and then stops logging application trace activities.

functions.name: TraceError
functions.documentation: Logs your own error message and its severity level to the trace file if tracing of this activity type has been enabled.

params.name: severity
params.description: A long whose value is a number you want to indicate the severity of the error

params.name: message
params.description: A string whose value is the error message you want to add to the trace file

functions.name: TraceOpen
functions.documentation: Opens a trace file with the specified name and enables logging of application trace activities.

params.name: filename
params.description: A read-only string used to identify the trace file

params.name: timer
params.description: A value of the enumerated datatype TimerKind that identifies the timer. Values are: Clock! -- Use the clock timer Process! -- Use the process timer Thread! -- Use the thread timer TimerNone! -- Do not log timer values

functions.name: TraceUser
functions.documentation: Logs the activity type value you specify to the trace file.

params.name: info
params.description: A long whose value is a reference number you want to associate with the logged activity

params.name: message
params.description: A string whose value is the activity type value you want to add to the trace file

functions.name: TriggerEvent
functions.documentation: Triggers an event associated with the specified object, which executes the script for that event immediately.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of any PowerBuilder object or control that has events associated with it.

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for objectname and a script must exist for the event in objectname.

params.name: word
params.description: A long value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs.)

params.name: long
params.description: A long value or a string that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage).

functions.name: TriggerPBEvent
functions.documentation: Triggers the specified user event in the child window contained in a PowerBuilder window ActiveX control.

params.name: activexcontrol
params.description: Identifier for the instance of the PowerBuilder window ActiveX control. When used in HTML, this is the NAME attribute of the object element. When used in other environments, this references the control that contains the PowerBuilder window ActiveX.

params.name: name
params.description: String specifying the name of the user event. This argument is passed by reference.

params.name: numarguments
params.description: Integer specifying the number of elements in the arguments array. The default is zero.

params.name: arguments
params.description: Variant array containing event arguments. In PowerBuilder, Variant maps to the Any datatype. This argument is passed by reference. If you specify this argument, you must also specify numarguments. If you do not specify this argument and the function contains arguments, populate the argument list by calling the SetArgElement function once for each argument. JavaScript cannot use this argument.

functions.name: Trim
functions.documentation: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want returned with leading and trailing spaces deleted

params.name: removeallspaces
params.description: A boolean indicating that all types of spaces should be deleted

functions.name: TrimW
functions.documentation: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string. This function is obsolete. It has the same behavior as Trim in all environments.

functions.name: Truncate
functions.documentation: Truncates a number to the specified number of decimal places.

params.name: x
params.description: The number you want to truncate.

params.name: n
params.description: The number of decimal places to which you want to truncate x. Valid values are 0 through 28.

functions.name: TypeOf
functions.documentation: Determines the type of an object or control, reported as a value of the Object enumerated datatype.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object or control for which you want the type

functions.name: Uncheck
functions.documentation: Removes the check mark, if any, next to an item a drop-down or cascading menu and sets the item's Checked property to false.

params.name: menuname
params.description: The fully qualified name of the menu selection from which you want to remove the checkmark, if any. The menu must be on a drop-down or cascading menu, not an item on a menu bar.

functions.name: Undo
functions.documentation: Cancels the last edit in an edit control, restoring the text to the content before the last change.

params.name: editname
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, MultiLineEdit, RichTextEdit, or SingleLineEdit in which you want to cancel (reverse) the last edit. For a DataWindow control, reverses the last edit in the edit control over the current row and column.

functions.name: UnitsToPixels
functions.documentation: Converts PowerBuilder units to pixels and reports the measurement. Because pixels are not usually square, you also specify whether to convert in the horizontal or vertical direction.

params.name: units
params.description: An integer or long whose value is the number of PowerBuilder units you want to convert to pixels

params.name: type
params.description: A value of the ConvertType enumerated datatype indicating how to convert the value: XUnitsToPixels! -- Convert the units in the horizontal direction YUnitsToPixels! -- Convert the units in the vertical direction

functions.name: UnregisterEvent
functions.documentation: Unregisters the user defined event that is registered using the RegisterEvent function.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: eventname
params.description: The name of the user-defined event to be unregistered.

functions.name: UnregisterObject
functions.documentation: Unregisters the PowerBuilder object.

params.name: objectname
params.description: The name of the object that has been registered. The name is case-sensitive.

functions.name: UpdateLinksDialog
functions.documentation: Attempts to find a file linked to an OLE container. If the linked file is not found, a dialog box tells the user and lets them bring up a second dialog box for find the file or changing the link.

params.name: objectref
params.description: The name of the OLE control or the fully qualified name of a OLE DWObject within a DataWindow control that contains the object for which you want to establish a link. The fully qualified name for a DWObject has this syntax: dwcontrol.Object.dwobjectname

functions.name: UpdateWithModel
functions.documentation: Updates data for one DataWindow, DataWindowChild, or DataStore using the .NET DataStore Web API. Commit changes to the database automatically if succeed, otherwise, roll back the changes automatically.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to the RestClient object.

params.name: dwControl
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control, DataStore, or child DataWindow

params.name: urlName
params.description: A string whose value is the URL of the .NET DataStore Web API.

params.name: accept
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the DataWindow control or DataStore should automatically perform an AcceptText prior to performing the update: True -- (Default) Perform AcceptText. The update is canceled if the data validation fails. False -- Do not perform AcceptText.

params.name: resetflag
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether dwcontrol should automatically reset the update flags: True -- (Default) Reset the flags. False -- Do not reset the flags.

params.name: tokenrequest
params.description: A reference to the TokenRequest object for supporting OAuth 2.0. If this parameter is used, the token settings in the SetOAuthToken and SetJWTToken functions will be ignored.

functions.name: Upper
functions.documentation: Converts all the characters in a string to uppercase.

params.name: string
params.description: The string you want to convert to uppercase letters

functions.name: UpperBound
functions.documentation: Obtains the upper bound of a dimension of an array.

params.name: array
params.description: The name of the array for which you want the upper bound of a dimension

params.name: n
params.description: The number of the dimension for which you want the upper bound. The default is 1

functions.name: UrlDecode
functions.documentation: Decodes a string value using URL decoder.

params.name: coder
params.description: The name of the CoderObject object.

params.name: variable
params.description: A string whose value is the data you want to decode with URL decoder.

functions.name: UrlEncode
functions.documentation: Encodes a blob value using URL encoder.

params.name: coder
params.description: The name of the CoderObject object.

params.name: variable
params.description: A blob whose value is the data you want to encode with URL encoder. When using the system blob function to convert a string to a blob, it is recommended to specify its encoding argument to be EncodingANSI! (for English characters only) or EncodingUTF8!, otherwise, the default EncodingUTF16LE! will be used.

functions.name: WebBrowserGet
functions.documentation: Gets the settings of the WebBrowser control. The global settings are also obtained.

params.name: n
params.description: The name of the setting. See WebBrowserSet for the list of available settings. The following values are read-only. SDKVersion -- Obtain the current WebView2 SDK version. The SDK build number is the third part of the SDK version number, for example, if the current WebView2 SDK Version is “107.0.1418.22”, the SDK build number is 1418. RuntimeVersion -- Obtain the current WebView2 Runtime version. The runtime build number is the third part of the runtime version number, for example, if the current WebView2 Runtime version is 105.0.1314.27, the runtime build number is 1314. Note Every time PowerBuilder is upgraded, the SDK version corresponding to WebBrowser will be updated. The runtime build number must be greater than or equal to the SDK build number, otherwise, compatibility issues may appear.

params.name: v
params.description: The value of the setting that is obtained.

functions.name: WebBrowserSet
functions.documentation: Configures the settings for the WebBrowser control. The global settings are also configured. Note that some settings must be set before the WebBrowser control is initialized. These settings should be set in the application Open event.

params.name: n
params.description: The name of the setting that is case insensitive. The setting can be: Important The following settings must be set before the window that contains the WebBrowser control is opened: RuntimeMode, FixedVersionRuntimePath, allow-file-access-from-files, UserDataFolder, Language, UserAgent, remote-allow-origins, and remote-debugging-port. It is recommended that you set them in the application Open event, or in any event that is triggered earlier than the window that contains the WebBrowser control is opened. The remote-allow-origins, and remote-debugging-port settings should be used only when the application is in the debug mode. For optimal performance, please comment out these settings when the application is not in the debug mode. If you have run the application (that includes the WebBrowser control) from PowerBuilder IDE, you may need to restart the application and the PowerBuilder IDE before the program can successfully initialize the WebBrowser control again. RuntimeMode -- The distribution mode of WebView2 Runtime. This setting has a higher precedence than the setting in the IDE > Application properties dialog box. FixedVersionRuntimePath -- The path of WebView2 Runtime Fixed Version. Both the relative path and absolute path are supported. DownloadPath -- The default download path. Both the relative path and absolute path are supported. By default, the system default download path will be used, for example, "C:\Users\appeon\Downloads" in 64-bit Windows 10. allow-file-access-from-files -- Whether to allow access to the local files (XML etc.). The value is "true" or "false" (the default). allow-file-access-from-files must be used with UserDataFolder, and each application must have its own UserDataFolder, otherwise WebBrowser may not work properly. UserDataFolder -- The folder that stores user data. Both the relative path and absolute path are supported. The default user data folder is %temp%\PB250UDF in the development machine and %temp%\<appname>UDF at the client. Language -- The language of WebBrowser control to be set. UserAgent -- The User-Agent request header that contains a characteristic string that allows the network protocol peers to identify the application type, operating system, software vendor or software version of the requesting software user agent. The default value of UserAgent cannot be obtained until the WebBrowser control is initialized and created. remote-allow-origins -- Which origins or domains are allowed to access the resource on a server. A wildcard "*" indicates any origin or domain is allowed to access the requested source. remote-debugging-port -- Whether to specify a port number that allows remote debugging of the current URL. When the remote debugging port is enabled, it allows developers to connect to the URL using a debugger and inspect its internal workings. To support the remote debugging: 1. Enable remote debugging on the specified port number, by executing the following script in the application Open event: li_return = WebBrowserSet("remote-debugging-port", "8210") li_return = WebBrowserSet("remote-allow-origins", "*") Every time when these scripts are executed, a unique page ID is generated. You can get and use this ID through the debugging APIs. 2. Run the debugging APIs in Chrome or Edge browser. For example: Access the main page: http://localhost:8210 Get the JSON string (which includes the page ID): http://localhost:8210/json Get the version information: http://localhost:8210/json/version Activate the page: http://localhost:8210/json/activate/{id}, for example, http://localhost:8210/json/activate/054A6021CB9DD4EDBDBFA55E4384EA38 Close the page: http://localhost:8210/json/close/{id} Remote control: http://localhost:8210/devtools/inspector.html?ws=localhost:8210/devtools/page/{id} Here is the returned information when debugging www.appeon.com:

params.name: v
params.description: The value of the setting to be set. When the name of the setting is "RuntimeMode", the following values can be specified: 0 -- Use the WebView2 Evergreen Runtime. 1 -- Use the WebView2 Runtime Fixed Version. 2 -- Use the WebView2 Evergreen Runtime by default; if it does not exist, use the Fixed Version. If you modify this value, you must restart PowerBuilder IDE and the application for the value to take effect; and this value has a higher precedence than the setting in the IDE > Application properties dialog box. When the name of the setting is "Language", this value is used to set the language in the UI of WebBrowser control, such as the context menu and the default dialog box. And it is also used in the accept-languages HTTP request header sent to the website. The format is language[-country] in which language is a two letter code in ISO 639 and country is a two character code in ISO 3166. When the name of the setting is "UserDataFolder", this value is used to set the user data directory.

functions.name: Which
functions.documentation: Allows a component to find out whether it is running on a transaction server.

params.name: transactionserver
params.description: Reference to the TransactionServer service instance

functions.name: WordCap
functions.documentation: Capitalizes the first letter of each word in a passed script. It sets the remaining letters in each word to lowercase.

params.name: text
params.description: String to be modified

functions.name: WorkSpaceHeight
functions.documentation: Obtains the height of the workspace within the boundaries of the specified window.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of the window for which you want the height of the workspace area

functions.name: WorkSpaceWidth
functions.documentation: Obtains the width of the workspace within the boundaries of the specified window.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of the window for which you want the width of the workspace area

functions.name: WorkSpaceX
functions.documentation: Obtains the distance between the left edge of a window's workspace and the left edge of the screen. For custom MDI frames, WorkSpaceX obtains the distance between the left edge of the frame window and the left side of the workspace area.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of the window for which you want the distance between the left edge of the workspace area and the left edge of the screen

functions.name: WorkSpaceY
functions.documentation: Obtains the distance between the top of a window's workspace and the top of the screen. For custom MDI frames, WorkSpaceY obtains the distance from the top of the frame window and the top of the workspace area. The top of the frame window is the lower edge of the menu bar or toolbar, if any.

params.name: windowname
params.description: The name of the window for which you want the distance between the top of the workspace area and the top of the screen

functions.name: WrapImage
functions.documentation: Specifies the image that the current PDFRichText object shall wrap around.

params.name: image
params.description: The image that the current PDFRichText object shall wrap around.

functions.name: Write
functions.documentation: Writes data to an opened OLE stream object.

params.name: olestream
params.description: The name of an OLE stream variable that has been opened

params.name: dataforstream
params.description: A string, blob, or character array whose value you want to write to olestream

functions.name: XMLParseFile
functions.documentation: Parses an XML file and determines whether the file is well formed or complies with a specified grammar.
functions.syntax: XMLParseFile ( xmlfilename {, validationscheme }{, parsingerrors } {, namespaceprocessing {, schemaprocessing {, schemafullchecking }}})

params.name: xmlstring
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the XML file to be parsed.

params.name: validationscheme
params.description: A value of the ValSchemeType enumerated datatype specifying the validation method used by the SAX parser. Values are: ValNever! -- Do not report validation errors. ValAlways! -- Always report validation errors. ValAuto! -- (default) Report validation errors only if a grammar is specified.

params.name: parsingerrors
params.description: A string buffer to which error messages can be saved. If not specified or set to null, errors display in a message box.

params.name: namespaceprocessing
params.description: A boolean specifying whether name space rules are enforced. When set to true, the parser enforces the constraints and rules defined by the W3C recommendation on namespaces in XML. If validationscheme is set to ValAlways! or ValAuto!, the document must contain a grammar that supports the use of namespaces. The default is false.

params.name: schemaprocessing
params.description: A boolean specifying whether schema support is enabled. When set to false, the parser does not process any schema found. If schemaprocessing is true, namespaceprocessing must also be set to true. The default is false.

params.name: schemafullchecking
params.description: A boolean specifying whether schema constraints are checked. When set to true, the schema grammar is checked for errors. Setting schemafullchecking to true has no effect unless schemaprocessing is also set to true. The default is false.

functions.name: XMLParseString
functions.documentation: Parses an XML string and determines whether the string is well formed or complies with a specified grammar.
functions.syntax: XMLParseString ( xmlstring {, validationscheme }{, parsingerrors } {, namespaceprocessing {, schemaprocessing {, schemafullchecking }}})

params.name: xmlstring
params.description: A string that holds the XML document to be parsed.

params.name: validationscheme
params.description: A value of the ValSchemeType enumerated datatype specifying the validation method used by the SAX parser. Values are: ValNever! -- Do not report validation errors. ValAlways! -- Always report validation errors. Use ValAlways! only when you know there is a DTD or schema against which the file can be validated. ValAuto! -- (default) Report validation errors only if a grammar is specified.

params.name: parsingerrors
params.description: A string buffer to which error messages can be saved. If not specified or set to null, errors are shown to the user in a dialog box.

params.name: namespaceprocessing
params.description: A boolean specifying whether name space rules are enforced. When set to true, the parser enforces the constraints and rules defined by the W3C recommendation on namespaces in XML. If validationscheme is set to ValAlways! or ValAuto!, the document must contain a grammar that supports the use of namespaces. The default is false.

params.name: schemaprocessing
params.description: A boolean specifying whether schema support is enabled. When set to false, the parser does not process any schema found. If schemaprocessing is true, namespaceprocessing must also be set to true. The default is false.

params.name: schemafullchecking
params.description: A boolean specifying whether schema constraints are checked. When set to true, the schema grammar is checked for errors. Setting schemafullchecking to true has no effect unless schemaprocessing is also set to true. The default is false.

functions.name: Year
functions.documentation: Determines the year of a date value.

params.name: date
params.description: The date from which you want the year

functions.name: Yield
functions.documentation: Yields control to other graphic objects, including objects that are not PowerBuilder objects. Yield checks the message queue and if there are messages in the queue, it pulls them from the queue.

functions.name: Zoom
functions.documentation: Scales the current view area.

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the WebBrowser control.

params.name: zoomlevel
params.description: The ratio to zoom the web page. Valid values are from 25 to 500 (in percentage). Values beyond this range have no zoom effect.
